3.1.m: The Narrative of the Kings of the Kṛta Age

3.1.s:
.. .. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ .. ..
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ..1..
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe brahmāyuṣi parārddhake ..

3.1.d:
॥ ॥ श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥ ॥
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ॥
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥1॥
॥ शौनक उवाच ॥ ॥
भविष्याख्ये महाकल्पे ब्रह्मायुषि परार्द्धके ॥
प्रथमेऽब्देह्नि तृतीये प्राप्ते वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m:
Salutation to Śrī Gaṇeśa. / Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa and to Nara, the best of humans, / and to the goddess Sarasvatī, and to Vyāsa, one should then utter [the word] ‘Victory’.
Śaunaka said: / In the great aeon named Bhaviṣya, in the second half of Brahmā’s lifespan, / during the first year, on the third day, when the Vaivasvata interval arrived,

3.1.s:
aṣṭāviṃśe satyayuge ke rājāno'bhavanmune ..
teṣāṃ rājyasya varṣāṇi tanme vada vicakṣaṇa .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
अष्टाविंशे सत्ययुगे के राजानोऽभवन्मुने ॥
तेषां राज्यस्य वर्षाणि तन्मे वद विचक्षण ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m: in the twenty-eighth Satya Age, which kings came to be, O sage? / Tell me that, O wise one, and the years of their rule.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kalpākhye śvetavārāhe brahmābdasya dinatraye ..
prāpte saptamuhūrte ca manurvaivasva to'bhavata .. 3 ..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कल्पाख्ये श्वेतवाराहे ब्रह्माब्दस्य दिनत्रये ॥
प्राप्ते सप्तमुहूर्ते च मनुर्वैवस्व तोऽभवत ॥ 3 ॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / In the aeon called Śvetavārāha, on the third day of Brahmā’s year, / and when the seventh muhūrta arrived, Vaivasvata Manu came into being.

3.1.s:
sa taptvā sarayūtīre tapo divyaṃ śataṃ samāḥ ..
tacchikkāto'bhavatputra ikṣvākuḥ sa mahīpatiḥ .. 4 ..
3.1.d:
स तप्त्वा सरयूतीरे तपो दिव्यं शतं समाः ॥
तच्छिक्कातोऽभवत्पुत्र इक्ष्वाकुः स महीपतिः ॥ 4 ॥
3.1.m: Having performed celestial austerity for a hundred years on the bank of the Sarayū, / from his sneeze was born a son, Ikṣvāku, who became ruler of the earth.

3.1.s:
brahmaṇo varadānena divyaṃ yānaṃ sa āptavān ..
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayitvā harau rājyaṃ nivedya ca .. 5..
3.1.d:
ब्रह्मणो वरदानेन दिव्यं यानं स आप्तवान् ॥
नारायणं पूजयित्वा हरौ राज्यं निवेद्य च ॥ 5॥
3.1.m: By a boon granted by Brahmā, he obtained a celestial conveyance. / Having worshipped Nārāyaṇa and offered his kingdom to Hari,

3.1.s:
ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇāmabdaṃ rājyaṃ tadā'karot ..
tasmājjāto vikukṣiśca śatahīnaṃ tadabdakam ..6..
3.1.d:
षट्त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणामब्दं राज्यं तदाऽकरोत् ॥
तस्माज्जातो विकुक्षिश्च शतहीनं तदब्दकम् ॥6॥
3.1.m: he then ruled for thirty-six thousand years. / From him Vikukṣi was born; having ruled for a period [of years]

3.1.s:
rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yātastasmājjāto ripuṃjayaḥ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatkakutsthasutaḥ smṛtaḥ..7..
3.1.d:
राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं यातस्तस्माज्जातो रिपुंजयः॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तत्ककुत्स्थसुतः स्मृतः॥7॥
3.1.m: diminished by a hundred, he went to heaven. From him Ripuṃjaya was born; / he ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was known as Kakutstha.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato'nenāṃsa ātmajaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto nṛpaḥ pṛthuḥ .. 8 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं ततोऽनेनांस आत्मजः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो नृपः पृथुः ॥ 8 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; then his son was Anenas. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him King Pṛthu was born.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ viṣvagaśvaśca tatsutaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādārdro nṛpo'bhavat .. 9 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं विष्वगश्वश्च तत्सुतः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादार्द्रो नृपोऽभवत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Viṣvagaśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him came King Ārdra.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhadrāśvastatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 3.1.1.10 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं भद्राश्वस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 3.1.1.10 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Bhadrāśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Yuvanāśva.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śravasthastatsuto'bhavat ..
satyapādaśca saṃjātaḥ prathamo bhārate'ntare .. 11 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं श्रवस्थस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
सत्यपादश्च संजातः प्रथमो भारतेऽन्तरे ॥ 11 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Śravastha. / Thus the first quarter of the Satya [Age] came to an end in the land of Bhārata.

3.1.s:
udayādastaparyaṃtaṃ tairnṛpairbhūmimaṃḍalam ..
bhuktaṃ nītiparairdevaiḥ śravasthena tu bhūtale..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bṛhadaśvastato'bhavat .. 12 ..
3.1.d:
उदयादस्तपर्यंतं तैर्नृपैर्भूमिमंडलम् ॥
भुक्तं नीतिपरैर्देवैः श्रवस्थेन तु भूतले॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं बृहदश्वस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 12 ॥
3.1.m: From sunrise to sunset, the orb of the earth was enjoyed by those kings / devoted to righteousness like gods. By Śravastha upon the earth, / a reign diminished by a hundred was held; from him came Bṛhadaśva.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmātkuvalayāśvakaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ dṛḍhāśvastatsuto'bhavat..13..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मात्कुवलयाश्वकः ॥
शतहीनं कृत राज्यं दृढाश्वस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्॥13॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; from him came Kuvalayāśva. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Dṛḍhāśva.

3.1.s:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattasmātputro nikuṃbhakaḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tatsaṃkaṭāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 14 ..
3.1.d:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तस्मात्पुत्रो निकुंभकः ॥
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्संकटाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 14 ॥
3.1.m: His reign was diminished by a thousand; from him was born his son Nikuṃbhaka. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Saṅkaṭāśva.

3.1.s:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattasmājjātaḥ prasenajit ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tadravaṇāśvastu tatsutaḥ .. 15 ..
3.1.d:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तस्माज्जातः प्रसेनजित् ॥
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तद्रवणाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 15 ॥
3.1.m: His reign was diminished by a thousand; from him was born Prasenajit. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Ravaṇāśva.

3.1.s:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tanmāṃdhātā tatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ purukutsastu tatsutaḥ ..16..
3.1.d:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तन्मांधाता तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं पुरुकुत्सस्तु तत्सुतः ॥16॥
3.1.m: His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was Māndhātṛ. / He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Purukutsa.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ triṃśadaśvastu tatsutaḥ ..
rathe yasya smṛtā vāhā vājinastriṃśato varāḥ .. 17 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं त्रिंशदश्वस्तु तत्सुतः ॥
रथे यस्य स्मृता वाहा वाजिनस्त्रिंशतो वराः ॥ 17 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled diminished by a hundred; his son was Triṃśadaśva, / to whose chariot were harnessed thirty excellent horses.

3.1.s:
anaraṇyastato jāto hyaṣṭāviṃśatsahasrakam ..
rājyaṃ dvitīyacaraṇe smṛtaṃ satyayugasya vai .. 18 ..
3.1.d:
अनरण्यस्ततो जातो ह्यष्टाविंशत्सहस्रकम् ॥
राज्यं द्वितीयचरणे स्मृतं सत्ययुगस्य वै ॥ 18 ॥
3.1.m: From him Anaraṇya was born; twenty-eight thousand [years] / is recorded as his reign in the second quarter of the Satya Age.

3.1.s:
pṛṣadaśvastato jāto rājyaṃ ṣaṣṭhasahasrakam ..
tadabdaṃ bhūtale kṛtvā pitṛlokamupāyayau .. 19 ..
3.1.d:
पृषदश्वस्ततो जातो राज्यं षष्ठसहस्रकम् ॥
तदब्दं भूतले कृत्वा पितृलोकमुपाययौ ॥ 19 ॥
3.1.m: From him Pṛṣadaśva was born; having ruled on earth / for sixty-six thousand years, he went to the world of the ancestors.

3.1.s:
haryaśvastu tato jāto viṣṇubhaktakule nṛpaḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattatsuto vasumānsmṛtaḥ .. 3.1.1.20 ..
3.1.d:
हर्यश्वस्तु ततो जातो विष्णुभक्तकुले नृपः ॥
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तत्सुतो वसुमान्स्मृतः ॥ 3.1.1.20 ॥
3.1.m: From him King Haryaśva was born in a lineage devoted to Viṣṇu. / His reign was diminished by a thousand; his son was known as Vasumat.

3.1.s:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattridhanvā tanayastataḥ ..
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tattena rājñā ca satkṛtam .. 21 ..
3.1.d:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्त्रिधन्वा तनयस्ततः ॥
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्तेन राज्ञा च सत्कृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.1.m: His reign was diminished by a thousand; then his son was Tridhanvan. / His reign was diminished by a thousand, and was virtuously held by that king.

3.1.s:
satyapādaḥ samāpto'yaṃ dvitīyo bhārate'ntare ..
tridhanvanaśca nṛpatestrapāraṇyastu vai sutaḥ .. 22 ..
3.1.d:
सत्यपादः समाप्तोऽयं द्वितीयो भारतेऽन्तरे ॥
त्रिधन्वनश्च नृपतेस्त्रपारण्यस्तु वै सुतः ॥ 22 ॥
3.1.m: This second quarter of the Satya [Age] came to an end in the land of Bhārata. / The son of King Tridhanvan was Trapāraṇya.

3.1.s:
sahasrahīnaṃ rājyaṃ tatkṛtvā svargamupāyayau ..
tasmājjātastriśaṃkuśca rājyaṃ varṣasahasrakam .. 23 ..
3.1.d:
सहस्रहीनं राज्यं तत्कृत्वा स्वर्गमुपाययौ ॥
तस्माज्जातस्त्रिशंकुश्च राज्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.1.m: Having ruled diminished by a thousand, he went to heaven. / From him Triśaṅku was born; his reign was a thousand years.

3.1.s:
chadmanā hīnatāṃ jāto hariścaṃdrastu tatsutaḥ ..
rājyaṃ viṃśatsahasraṃ ca rohito nāma tatsutaḥ ..24 ..
3.1.d:
छद्मना हीनतां जातो हरिश्चंद्रस्तु तत्सुतः ॥
राज्यं विंशत्सहस्रं च रोहितो नाम तत्सुतः ॥24 ॥
3.1.m: He fell into lowliness through deceit; his son was Hariścandra. / His reign was twenty thousand [years]; his son was named Rohita.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ hārītastanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ caṃcubhūpaśca tatsutaḥ .. 25 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं हारीतस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं चंचुभूपश्च तत्सुतः ॥ 25 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled equal to his father; his son was Hārīta. / He ruled equal to his father; his son was King Cañcu.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ hi rājyaṃ tadvijayo nāma tatsutaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ hi rājyaṃ tadrurūkastanayastataḥ .. 26 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं हि राज्यं तद्विजयो नाम तत्सुतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं हि राज्यं तद्रुरूकस्तनयस्ततः ॥ 26 ॥
3.1.m: His reign was indeed equal to his father’s; his son was named Vijaya. / His reign was indeed equal to his father’s; from him his son was Ruruka.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sagarastanayo'bhavat ..
bhūpāśca bāhusenāntā vaiṣṇavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ..27..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सगरस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
भूपाश्च बाहुसेनान्ता वैष्णवाः परिकीर्तिताः॥27॥
3.1.m: He ruled equal to his father; his son was Sagara. / The kings up to Bāhusena are proclaimed as Vaiṣṇavas.

3.1.s:
rājyamānaṃ kṛtaṃ samyagbhūpairvaivasvatādibhiḥ ..
maṇisvarṇasamṛddhiśca bahvannaṃ bahudugdhakam .. 28 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यमानं कृतं सम्यग्भूपैर्वैवस्वतादिभिः ॥
मणिस्वर्णसमृद्धिश्च बह्वन्नं बहुदुग्धकम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.1.m: The span of rule was well maintained by the kings beginning with Vaivasvata. / There was an abundance of jewels and gold, plenty of food and plenty of milk.

3.1.s:
pūrṇo dharmastadā bhūmyāṃ mune satyayugasya vai ..
tṛtīyacaraṇe madhye sagaro nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 29 ..
3.1.d:
पूर्णो धर्मस्तदा भूम्यां मुने सत्ययुगस्य वै ॥
तृतीयचरणे मध्ये सगरो नाम भूपतिः ॥ 29 ॥
3.1.m: Righteousness was then complete on earth, O sage, during the Satya Age. / In the middle of its third quarter, there was a king named Sagara.

3.1.s:
śivabhaktaḥ sadācārastatputrāḥ sāgarāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
triṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ tadrājyaṃ vai munibhiḥ smṛtam .. 3.1.1.30 ..
3.1.d:
शिवभक्तः सदाचारस्तत्पुत्राः सागराः स्मृताः ॥
त्रिंशत्सहस्रवर्षं तद्राज्यं वै मुनिभिः स्मृतम् ॥ 3.1.1.30 ॥
3.1.m: He was devoted to Śiva and of noble conduct; his sons are known as the Sāgaras. / His reign is remembered by sages as thirty thousand years.

3.1.s:
naṣṭeṣu sāgareṣvevamasamañjasa ātmajaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamaṃśumāṃstatsuto'bhavat ..31..
3.1.d:
नष्टेषु सागरेष्वेवमसमञ्जस आत्मजः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमंशुमांस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥31॥
3.1.m: When the sons of Sagara were thus destroyed, his son was Asamañjasa. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; his son was Aṃśumān.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dilīpastatsuto'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto bhagīrathaḥ ..32..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं दिलीपस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो भगीरथः ॥32॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Dilīpa was his son. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; from him was born Bhagīratha.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śrutasenastato'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nābhāgastanayastataḥ ..33..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं श्रुतसेनस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं नाभागस्तनयस्ततः ॥33॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Śrutasena came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; his son Nābhāga came after him.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamambarīṣastato'bhavat ..
śaivāḥ ṣaṭśrutasenāntā nābhāgo vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ .. 34 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमम्बरीषस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
शैवाः षट्श्रुतसेनान्ता नाभागो वैष्णवो नृपः ॥ 34 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ambarīṣa came after him. / The six ending with Śrutasena were Śaivas; King Nābhāga was a Vaiṣṇava.

3.1.s:
satyapādaḥ samāpto'yaṃ tṛtīyo bhārateṃtare ..
aṃvarīṣeṇa bhūpena śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 35 ..
3.1.d:
सत्यपादः समाप्तोऽयं तृतीयो भारतेंतरे ॥
अंवरीषेण भूपेन शतहीनं कृतं पदम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.1.m: This third quarter of the Satya[yuga] was completed within Bhārata. / By King Ambarīṣa a status of a hundred [years] less was made.

3.1.s:
caturthe caraṇe tasya cāṣṭādaśa sahasrakam ..
abdaṃ rājyaṃ śubhaṃ jñātaṃ karmabhūmyāṃ ca bhārate .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
चतुर्थे चरणे तस्य चाष्टादश सहस्रकम् ॥
अब्दं राज्यं शुभं ज्ञातं कर्मभूम्यां च भारते ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: In its fourth quarter, an auspicious rule of eighteen thousand / years is known in Bhārata, the land of action.

3.1.s:
ekonatriṃśadvarṣāṇi rājyaṃ tattriṃśatāni ca ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ siṃdhudvīpo'mbarīṣajaḥ .. 37 ..
3.1.d:
एकोनत्रिंशद्वर्षाणि राज्यं तत्त्रिंशतानि च ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सिंधुद्वीपोऽम्बरीषजः ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: Twenty-nine years and thirty hundred [years] was that reign. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Sindhudvīpa was the son of Ambarīṣa.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamayutāśvastato'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamṛtuparṇastu tatsutaḥ .. 38 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमयुताश्वस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यमृतुपर्णस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 38 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ayutāśva came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Ṛtuparṇa was his son.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sarvakāmo nṛpastataḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nṛpaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ .. 39 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सर्वकामो नृपस्ततः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं नृपः कल्माषपादकः ॥ 39 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; King Sarvakāma came after him. / He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; the king was Kalmāṣapāda.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sudāsastanayo'bhavat..
tasmādaśamakaścaiva madayantyā vaśiṣṭhajaḥ .. 3.1.1.40 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं सुदासस्तनयोऽभवत्॥
तस्मादशमकश्चैव मदयन्त्या वशिष्ठजः ॥ 3.1.1.40 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Sudāsa became his son. / From him [was born] Aśmaka, fathered by Vasiṣṭha upon Madayantī.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ harivarmā tato'bhavat ..
sapta bhūpāḥ sudāsāntā vaiṣṇavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..41..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं हरिवर्मा ततोऽभवत् ॥
सप्त भूपाः सुदासान्ता वैष्णवाः परिकीर्तिताः ॥41॥
3.1.m: He ruled for [the previous period] less a hundred [years]; Harivarmā came after him. / The seven kings ending with Sudāsa are celebrated as Vaiṣṇavas.

3.1.s:
guruśāpāttu saudāso rājyāṅgaṃ gurave'rpayat ..
gokarṇaliṃgabhaktaśca śaivaḥ samaya ucyate .. 42 ..
3.1.d:
गुरुशापात्तु सौदासो राज्याङ्गं गुरवेऽर्पयत् ॥
गोकर्णलिंगभक्तश्च शैवः समय उच्यते ॥ 42 ॥
3.1.m: Through the curse of his guru, the son of Sudāsa offered the kingdom's sovereignty to the guru. / Devoted to the liṅga of Gokarṇa, he is called an adherent of the Śaiva doctrine.

3.1.s:
harivarmā śamakajo vaiśyavatsādhupūjakaḥ ..
ūnatriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathā saptaśatāni vai .. 43 ..
3.1.d:
हरिवर्मा शमकजो वैश्यवत्साधुपूजकः ॥
ऊनत्रिंशत्सहस्राणि तथा सप्तशतानि वै ॥ 43 ॥
3.1.m: Harivarmā, born of Aśmaka, worshipped virtuous men like a vaiśya. / For twenty-nine thousand and seven hundred [years],

3.1.s:
harivarmā'karodrājyaṃ tasmāddaśaratho'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāddillīvayassutaḥ .. 44 ..
3.1.d:
हरिवर्माऽकरोद्राज्यं तस्माद्दशरथोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्दिल्लीवयस्सुतः ॥ 44 ॥
3.1.m: Harivarmā ruled; from him came Daśaratha. / He ruled equally to his father; from him his son Dilīpa [came].

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhṛpo viśvāsahastataḥ ..
rājyaṃ daśasahasraṃ tanniyajñaḥ prākṛto nṛpaḥ .. 45 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं भृपो विश्वासहस्ततः ॥
राज्यं दशसहस्रं तन्नियज्ञः प्राकृतो नृपः ॥ 45 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled equally to his father; then King Viśvasaha [came]. / That reign was ten thousand [years]; the king performed no sacrifice and was vulgar.

3.1.s:
tadadharmapratāpena hyanāvṛṣṭistadā'bhavat ..
śatavarṣamanā vṛṣṭissarvarājyaṃ vyanāśayat .. 46 ..
3.1.d:
तदधर्मप्रतापेन ह्यनावृष्टिस्तदाऽभवत् ॥
शतवर्षमना वृष्टिस्सर्वराज्यं व्यनाशयत् ॥ 46 ॥
3.1.m: Due to the power of his unrighteousness, a drought occurred then. / A drought of a hundred years destroyed the entire kingdom.

3.1.s:
yajñaṃ kṛtvā vaśiṣṭhastu rājñīvacanatatparaḥ ..
yajñātkhaṭvāṃga utpannaḥ khaṭvāṃgaṃ śastramudvahan .. 47 ..
3.1.d:
यज्ञं कृत्वा वशिष्ठस्तु राज्ञीवचनतत्परः ॥
यज्ञात्खट्वांग उत्पन्नः खट्वांगं शस्त्रमुद्वहन् ॥ 47 ॥
3.1.m: Having performed a sacrifice, Vasiṣṭha, devoted to the queen's word— / from the sacrifice Khaṭvāṅga was born, bearing the khaṭvāṅga weapon.

3.1.s:
indrasāhāyyamagamadrājyaṃ triṃśatsahasrakam ..
kṛtvā .tatra varaṃ labdhvā devebhyo muktitāṃ gataḥ ... 48 ..
3.1.d:
इन्द्रसाहाय्यमगमद्राज्यं त्रिंशत्सहस्रकम् ॥
कृत्वा ।तत्र वरं लब्ध्वा देवेभ्यो मुक्तितां गतः ॥। 48 ॥
3.1.m: He went to the aid of Indra; having ruled for thirty thousand [years] / and having obtained a boon from the gods there, he attained liberation.

3.1.s:
khaṭṭāṃgāddīrghabāhuśca rājyaṃ viṃśatsa hasrakam ..
tasmātsudarśano jāto devīpūjanatatparaḥ .. 49 ..
3.1.d:
खट्टांगाद्दीर्घबाहुश्च राज्यं विंशत्स हस्रकम् ॥
तस्मात्सुदर्शनो जातो देवीपूजनतत्परः ॥ 49 ॥
3.1.m: From Khaṭvāṅga [came] Dīrghabāhu; his reign was twenty thousand [years]. / From him was born Sudarśana, devoted to the worship of the Goddess.

3.1.s:
vaiṣṇavā dāśarathyaṃ tāstrayo vikhyātasadbalāḥ ..
khaṭvāṃgo dīrghabāhuśca vaiṣṇavau parikīrtitau .. 3.1.1.50 ..
3.1.d:
वैष्णवा दाशरथ्यं तास्त्रयो विख्यातसद्बलाः ॥
खट्वांगो दीर्घबाहुश्च वैष्णवौ परिकीर्तितौ ॥ 3.1.1.50 ॥
3.1.m: Those three ending with the son of Daśaratha, renowned for true strength, were Vaiṣṇavas. / Khaṭvāṅga and Dīrghabāhu are celebrated as Vaiṣṇavas.

3.1.s:
sudarśano mahāprājñaḥ kāśīrājasutāṃ nṛpaḥ ..
udūhya bhūpatīñjitvā devīsevāprasādataḥ.. ..
rājyaṃ bharatakhaṇḍāntamadadhaddharmato nṛpaḥ ..
varṣapañcasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ cakre sa bhūpatiḥ .. 52 ..
3.1.d:
सुदर्शनो महाप्राज्ञः काशीराजसुतां नृपः ॥
उदूह्य भूपतीञ्जित्वा देवीसेवाप्रसादतः॥ ॥
राज्यं भरतखण्डान्तमदधद्धर्मतो नृपः ॥
वर्षपञ्चसहस्राणि राज्यं चक्रे स भूपतिः ॥ 52 ॥
3.1.m: King Sudarśana, endowed with great wisdom, married the daughter of the king of Kāśī; / having conquered the kings through the grace of worshipping the Goddess, / the king held the realm up to the borders of Bharatakhaṇḍa with righteousness. / That ruler ruled for five thousand years.

3.1.s:
svapnamadhye vacaḥ proktaṃ mahākālyā nṛpāya vai ..
vatsa tvaṃ priyayā sārddhaṃ vaśiṣṭhādibhiranvitaḥ .. 53 ..
3.1.d:
स्वप्नमध्ये वचः प्रोक्तं महाकाल्या नृपाय वै ॥
वत्स त्वं प्रियया सार्द्धं वशिष्ठादिभिरन्वितः ॥ 53 ॥
3.1.m: In a dream, a speech was indeed uttered to the king by Mahākālī: / 'O child, accompanied by your beloved and joined by Vasiṣṭha and others,

3.1.s:
himālayaṃ giriṃ prāpya vāsaṃ kuru mahāmate ..
mahāvāyuprabhāvena kṣayo bharatakhaṃḍake .. 54 ..
3.1.d:
हिमालयं गिरिं प्राप्य वासं कुरु महामते ॥
महावायुप्रभावेन क्षयो भरतखंडके ॥ 54 ॥
3.1.m: reach the Himālaya mountain and make your residence [there], O noble-minded one. / By the power of a mighty wind, destruction [shall come] in Bharatakhaṇḍa.

3.1.s:
ratnākaraḥ paścimo'bdhistasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
mahodadhiḥ pūrvato'bdhistasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 55 ..
3.1.d:
रत्नाकरः पश्चिमोऽब्धिस्तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः ॥
महोदधिः पूर्वतोऽब्धिस्तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः ॥ 55 ॥
3.1.m: Ratnākara is the western ocean; its islands have gone to destruction. / Mahodadhi is the eastern ocean; its islands have gone to destruction.

3.1.s:
vāḍavo'bdhirdakṣiṇe ca tasya dvīpāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
himābdhiruttare tasya sagaraiḥ khanito hi saḥ .. 56 ..
3.1.d:
वाडवोऽब्धिर्दक्षिणे च तस्य द्वीपाः क्षयं गताः ॥
हिमाब्धिरुत्तरे तस्य सगरैः खनितो हि सः ॥ 56 ॥
3.1.m: The Vāḍava ocean is in the south; its islands have gone to destruction. / The Himābdhi is in the north; indeed, it was dug by the sons of Sagara.

3.1.s:
ye dvīpāstu suvikhyātāste'pi sarve layaṃ gatāḥ ..
bhārato varṣa evāsau vatsare saptame'hani .. 57 ..
3.1.d:
ये द्वीपास्तु सुविख्यातास्तेऽपि सर्वे लयं गताः ॥
भारतो वर्ष एवासौ वत्सरे सप्तमेऽहनि ॥ 57 ॥
3.1.m: The islands that are renowned—they too have all gone to dissolution. / This very land of Bhārata, on the seventh day of the year,

3.1.s:
sajīvaḥ pralayaṃ yāyāttasmāttvaṃ jīvito bhava ..
tatheti matvā sa nṛpaḥ parvataṃ vai himālayam .. 58 ..
3.1.d:
सजीवः प्रलयं यायात्तस्मात्त्वं जीवितो भव ॥
तथेति मत्वा स नृपः पर्वतं वै हिमालयम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.1.m: along with living creatures, will go to dissolution; therefore, remain alive.' / Thinking, 'So be it,' that king went to the Himālaya mountain

3.1.s:
prāptavānmukhyabhūpaiśca mukhyavaiśyairdvijaiḥ saha ..
pañcavarṣapramāṇena vāyustejaḥkramājjalam .. 59 ..
3.1.d:
प्राप्तवान्मुख्यभूपैश्च मुख्यवैश्यैर्द्विजैः सह ॥
पञ्चवर्षप्रमाणेन वायुस्तेजःक्रमाज्जलम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.1.m: with foremost kings, foremost vaiśyas, and twice-borns. / For a measure of five years, wind, fire, and gradually water,

3.1.s:
śarkarā ca mahīṃ prāptāstato jīvāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
paṃcavarṣamite kāle jalaṃ jātā vasuṃdharā ..3.1.1.60..
3.1.d:
शर्करा च महीं प्राप्तास्ततो जीवाः क्षयं गताः ॥
पंचवर्षमिते काले जलं जाता वसुंधरा ॥3.1.1.60॥
3.1.m: and gravel reached the earth; then living beings perished. / In the time measured by five years, the earth turned to water.

3.1.s:
śāṃto bhūtvā punarvāyurjalaṃ sarvamaśoṣayat ..
daśavarṣāṃtare bhūmiḥ sthalī bhūtvā pradṛśyate .. 61 .. ..
tretāyugabhūpākhyānavarṇanam
3.1.d:
शांतो भूत्वा पुनर्वायुर्जलं सर्वमशोषयत् ॥
दशवर्षांतरे भूमिः स्थली भूत्वा प्रदृश्यते ॥ 61 ॥ ॥
त्रेतायुगभूपाख्यानवर्णनम्
3.1.m:
Becoming calm again, the wind dried up all the water. / Within ten years, the earth is seen having become dry land.
Description of the Narrative of the Kings of the Tretāyuga

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāguruvāsare ..
sudarśano janaiḥ sārddhamayodhyāmagamatpunaḥ .. 1 ..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वैशाखशुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयागुरुवासरे ॥
सुदर्शनो जनैः सार्द्धमयोध्यामगमत्पुनः ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / On Thursday, the third [tithi] of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, / Sudarśana returned to Ayodhyā together with the people.

3.1.s:
māyādevīprabhāveṇa puraṃ sarvaṃ manoharam ..
mahāvṛddhiyutaṃ prāptaṃ bahvannaṃ sarvaratnakam .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
मायादेवीप्रभावेण पुरं सर्वं मनोहरम् ॥
महावृद्धियुतं प्राप्तं बह्वन्नं सर्वरत्नकम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m: By the power of the goddess Māyā, the entire charming city / was reached, filled with great prosperity, abundant food, and all manner of jewels.

3.1.s:
daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi rājyaṃ kṛtvā sudarśanaḥ ..
prāptavāñchāśvataṃ lokaṃ dilīpastatsuto'bhavat .. 3 ..
3.1.d:
दशवर्ष सहस्राणि राज्यं कृत्वा सुदर्शनः ॥
प्राप्तवाञ्छाश्वतं लोकं दिलीपस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.1.m: Having ruled for ten thousand years, Sudarśana / attained the eternal world; Dilīpa became his son.

3.1.s:
nandinīvaradānena tatputro raghuruttamaḥ ..
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi dilīpo rājyasatkṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
3.1.d:
नन्दिनीवरदानेन तत्पुत्रो रघुरुत्तमः ॥
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दिलीपो राज्यसत्कृतः ॥ 4 ॥
3.1.m: Through the boon granted by Nandinī, his son was the best Raghu. / For ten thousand years Dilīpa was honoured with kingship.

3.1.s:
rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca raghuṇā dilīpānte pitussamam ..
raghuvaṃśastataḥ khyātastretāyāṃ bhṛgunandana .. 5 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यं कृतं च रघुणा दिलीपान्ते पितुस्समम् ॥
रघुवंशस्ततः ख्यातस्त्रेतायां भृगुनन्दन ॥ 5 ॥
3.1.m: And rule was exercised by Raghu, equal to his father, after Dilīpa. / From then the lineage of Raghu was renowned in the Tretā[yuga], O descendant of Bhṛgu.

3.1.s:
viprasya varadānena tatputro'ja iti smṛtaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāddaśaratho'bhavat .. 6 ..
3.1.d:
विप्रस्य वरदानेन तत्पुत्रोऽज इति स्मृतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्दशरथोऽभवत् ॥ 6 ॥
3.1.m: Through the boon granted by a brāhmaṇa, his son is remembered as Aja. / He ruled equally to his father; from him Daśaratha was born.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādrāmo hariḥ svayam ..
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi rāmarājyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 7 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्रामो हरिः स्वयम् ॥
एकादश सहस्राणि रामराज्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled equally to his father; from him [was born] Rāma, Hari himself. / Eleven thousand [years] is proclaimed as the reign of Rāma.

3.1.s:
tasya putraḥ kuśo nāma rājyaṃ daśasahasrakam ..
atithirnāma tatputraḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pituḥ samam .. 8 ..
3.1.d:

3.1.m: His son was named Kuśa; his rule was ten thousand [years]. / His son was named Atithi; he ruled equally to his father.

3.1.m: His son was named Nibandha; he ruled equally to his father. / From him was born the one named Nala, a worshipper of Śakti in the Tretā[yuga].

3.1.m: He ruled equally to his father; from him Nābha became the son. / He ruled equally to his father; Puṇḍarīka became the son.

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him was born Ahīnaja. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him then [came] a son named Kuru.

3.1.m: Kurukṣetra was established by him, [measuring] a hundred yojanas in the Tretā[yuga]. / Thus ended the first quarter of the Tretā[yuga] in the interval of Bhārata.

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Pāriyātra was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Dalapāla was his son after that.

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Svarṇanābhi was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Puṣpasena was his son.

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Dhruvasaṃdhi was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Apavarmā was his son.

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Śīghragantā was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Marupāla was his son.

3.1.d:

पितुस्तुज्यं कृतं राज्यं सुसंधिस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
त्रेतापादः समाप्तोऽयं प्रथमो भारतेंतरे ॥ 21 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Prasūvaśruta is spoken of. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Susaṃdhi was his son. / Thus ended the first quarter of the Tretā[yuga] in the interval of Bhārata.

3.1.s:
udayādudayaṃ yāvadrājñā tatra susaṃdhinā ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ māmarbastanayastataḥ .. 22 ..
3.1.d:
उदयादुदयं यावद्राज्ञा तत्र सुसंधिना ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मामर्बस्तनयस्ततः ॥ 22 ॥
3.1.m: From horizon to horizon by that King Susaṃdhi, / the kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Māmarba was the son after him.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mahā'śvastanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bṛhadbālaḥ sutastataḥ .. 23 ..

पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बृहद्बालः सुतस्ततः ॥ 23 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Mahāśva was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Bṛhadbāla was his son after that.

pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamurukṣepastato'bhavat..24..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बृहदैशान एव तत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमुरुक्षेपस्ततोऽभवत्॥24॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Bṛhadaiśāna indeed [ruled] then. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Urukṣepa was born after him.

pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājya vatsavyūhastato'bhavat .. 25 ..
3.1.d:

पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्य वत्सव्यूहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 25 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Vatsapāla was his son. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Vatsavyūha was born after him.

पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं प्रतिव्योमा ततो नृपः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुतो देवकरस्ततः ॥ 26 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Prativyoman was king after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; the son Devakara was after him.

pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sahadevastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bṛhadaśvastato nṛpaḥ .. 27 ..

पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बृहदश्वस्ततो नृपः ॥ 27 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Sahadeva was born after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Bṛhadaśva was king after him.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhānuratnastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ supratīkastato'bhavat .. 28 ..
3.1.d:

3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Bhānuratna was born after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Supratīka was born after him.

pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sunakṣatrastato'bhavat .. 29 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मरुदेवस्सुतस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुनक्षत्रस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 29 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Marudeva was his son after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Sunakṣatra was born after him.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sutaḥ keśīnarastataḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamantarikṣastato nṛpaḥ .. 3.1.2.30 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुतः केशीनरस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमन्तरिक्षस्ततो नृपः ॥ 3.1.2.30 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; his son was Keśīnara after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Antarikṣa was king after him.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ suvarṇāṃgo nṛpo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasya putro hyamitrajit .. 31 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुवर्णांगो नृपोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्य पुत्रो ह्यमित्रजित् ॥ 31 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Suvarṇāṅga was king. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; his son was Amitrajit.

3.1.d: पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं बृहद्राजस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Bṛhadrāja was born after him.

pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjātaḥ kṛtañjayaḥ .. 33 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धर्मराजस्ततो नृपः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातः कृतञ्जयः ॥ 33 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Dharmarāja was king after him. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him was born Kṛtañjaya.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto raṇañjayaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sañjayastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 34 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो रणञ्जयः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सञ्जयस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः ॥ 34 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him was born Raṇañjaya. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Sañjaya was known as his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatputraḥ śākyavardhanaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ krodhadānastu tatsutaḥ .. .. 35 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तत्पुत्रः शाक्यवर्धनः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं क्रोधदानस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ ॥ 35 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; his son was Śākyavardhana. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Krodhadāna was his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādatulavikramaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjātaḥ prasenajit .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादतुलविक्रमः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातः प्रसेनजित् ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him was born At विक्रम [Atulavikrama]. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; from him was born Prasenajit.

3.1.d:
पितुस्तल्यं कृतं राज्यं तत्पुत्रः शूद्रकः स्मृतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुरथस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; his son is remembered as Śūdraka. / The kingdom was ruled equally to his father; Suratha was his son.

3.1.s:
piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sarve tu raghuvaṃśajāḥ ..
pañcaṣaṣṭimitā bhūpā devīpūjanatatparāḥ .. 38 ..
3.1.d:

3.1.m: All those born in the Raghu dynasty ruled the kingdom for half their fathers' [reigns]. / Sixty-five kings were devoted to the worship of the Goddess.

3.1.s:
hiṃsāyajñaparāḥ sarve svargalokamito gatāḥ ..
buddhā jātāśca ye putrāste sarvai varṇasaṃkarāḥ .. 39 ..
3.1.d:

बुद्धा जाताश्च ये पुत्रास्ते सर्वै वर्णसंकराः ॥ 39 ॥
3.1.m: All devoted to violent sacrifices, they went from here to the heavenly world. / But those sons who were born as Buddhists were all of mixed caste.

3.1.s:
tretātṛtīyacaraṇaprārambhena navatāṃ gatāḥ ..
indreṇa preṣito bhūmau candramā rohiṇīpatiḥ .. 3.1.2.40 ..
3.1.d:
त्रेतातृतीयचरणप्रारम्भेन नवतां गताः ॥
इन्द्रेण प्रेषितो भूमौ चन्द्रमा रोहिणीपतिः ॥ 3.1.2.40 ॥
3.1.m: At the beginning of the third quarter of the Tretā[yuga], they came to renewal. / Sent by Indra to the earth, the Moon, the husband of Rohiṇī,

prayāganagare ramye bhūmirājayamacīkarat..
viṣṇubhaktaścandramāśca śivapūjanatatparaḥ .. 41 ..
3.1.d:
प्रयागनगरे रम्ये भूमिराजयमचीकरत्॥
विष्णुभक्तश्चन्द्रमाश्च शिवपूजनतत्परः ॥ 41 ॥
3.1.m: caused earthly kingship to be exercised in the lovely city of Prayāga. / The Moon was a devotee of Viṣṇu, devoted to the worship of Śiva.

aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ ..42 ..

Puru, the son of the Daitya woman, in the netherworld of Vṛṣaparvan,

3.1.m:

3.1.m:

He ruled equal to his father; after him came Dhanayāti.

3.1.m:

He ruled equal to his father; from him was born his son Raṃtinara.

3.1.m:

He ruled equal to his father; after him was his son Saṃvaraṇa.

3.1.m:

for a hundred years. Then Sūrya [gave] a maiden named Tapatī

3.1.m:
to Saṃvaraṇa, being pleased; the king went to the world of the sun.
Then, through the power of Māyā, the age met with dissolution.

3.1.s:
catvāraḥ sāgarā vṛddhā bhārataṃ kṣayatāṃ gatam ..
dvivarṣe sāgare bhūmiruṣitvā bhūdharaissaha .. 69 ..

द्विवर्षे सागरे भूमिरुषित्वा भूधरैस्सह ॥ 69 ॥
3.1.m:

Having dwelt within the ocean for two years along with the mountains,

agastyatejasā bhūmiḥ sthalī bhūtvā pradṛśyate .. 3.1.2.70 ..

अगस्त्यतेजसा भूमिः स्थली भूत्वा प्रदृश्यते ॥ 3.1.2.70 ॥
3.1.m:
the oceans became dry through the power of a mighty wind.
By the splendor of Agastya, the earth, having become dry land, is seen again.

pañcavarṣāṃtare bhūmirvṛkṣadūrvādisaṃyutā ..

And by the command of Sūrya, Saṃvarṇa, together with Tapatī and the sage,

together with Vasiṣṭha and the foremost of the three social classes, returned.

saṃvarṇaśca mahīpālaḥ kasminkāle samāgataḥ ..
lomaharṣaṇa me brūhi dvāparasya nṛpāṃstathā .. 1 ..
3.1.d:
॥ शौनक उवाच ॥ ॥
संवर्णश्च महीपालः कस्मिन्काले समागतः ॥
लोमहर्षण मे ब्रूहि द्वापरस्य नृपांस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m:
Śaunaka said:
At what time did King Saṃvarṇa return?
Tell me, Lomaharṣaṇa, and also tell of the kings of the Dvāpara.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bhādrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu trayodaśyāṃ bhṛgau dine ..
saṃvarṇo munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ pratiṣṭhāne samāgataḥ .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
भाद्रस्य कृष्णपक्षे तु त्रयोदश्यां भृगौ दिने ॥
संवर्णो मुनिभिः सार्द्धं प्रतिष्ठाने समागतः ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m:
Sūta said:
In the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, on the thirteenth lunar day, on a Friday,
Saṃvarṇa returned to Pratiṣṭhāna together with the sages.

arddhakrośonnataṃ harmyaṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .. 3 ...

अर्द्धक्रोशोन्नतं हर्म्यं रचितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥ 3 ॥।
3.1.m:

A palace half a krośa high was constructed by Viśvakarman.

3.1.s:

yaduvaṃśe sātvataśca madhurābhūpatiḥ kṛtaḥ .. 4 ..

3.1.m:

And in the Yadu lineage, Sātvata was made king of Mathurā.

krameṇa varddhitā bhūpāḥ prajābhiḥ sahitā bhuvi .. 5 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छवंशे श्मश्रुपालो मरुदेशस्य भूपतिः ॥
क्रमेण वर्द्धिता भूपाः प्रजाभिः सहिता भुवि ॥ 5 ॥
3.1.m:
In the Mleccha lineage, Śmaśrupāla became king of the Maru region.
In due course, the kings flourished on earth together with their subjects.

3.1.s:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi saṃvarṇo bhūpatiḥ smṛtaḥ ..
tasyātmajo'yamarcājñaḥ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pitussamam .. 6 ..
3.1.d:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि संवर्णो भूपतिः स्मृतः ॥
तस्यात्मजोऽयमर्चाज्ञः कृतं राज्यं पितुस्समम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.1.m:
Saṃvarṇa is remembered to have been king for ten thousand years.
His son was this Arcājña, who ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
tasya putraḥ sūrijāpī piturarddhaṃ ca rājyakṛt ..
sūryayajñastasya putraḥ saurayajñaparāyaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
3.1.d:
तस्य पुत्रः सूरिजापी पितुरर्द्धं च राज्यकृत् ॥
सूर्ययज्ञस्तस्य पुत्रः सौरयज्ञपरायणः ॥ 7 ॥
3.1.m:
His son was Sūrijāpin, who ruled for half his father's time.
His son was Sūryayajña, devoted to solar sacrifices.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādātithyavardhanaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dvādaśātmā tu tatsutaḥ .. 8 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादातिथ्यवर्धनः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं द्वादशात्मा तु तत्सुतः ॥ 8 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled for [his father's time] less a hundred [years]. From him came Ātithyavardhana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Dvādaśātman.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ tasmājjāto divākaraḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjātaḥ prabhākaraḥ .. 9 ...
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृत राज्यं तस्माज्जातो दिवाकरः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातः प्रभाकरः ॥ 9 ॥।
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him was born Divākara.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him was born Prabhākara.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhāsvadātmā ca tatsutaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vivasvajjñastadātmajaḥ .. 3.1.3.10 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं भास्वदात्मा च तत्सुतः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं विवस्वज्ज्ञस्तदात्मजः ॥ 3.1.3.10 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Bhāsvadātman.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Vivasvajjña.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ haridaśvārcanastataḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvaikartanaḥ sutaḥ .. 11 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं हरिदश्वार्चनस्ततः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वैकर्तनः सुतः ॥ 11 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]. After him came Haridaśvārcana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him was born his son Vaikartana.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ stasmādarkeṣṭimānsutaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmānmārtaṃḍavatsalaḥ .. .. 12 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं स्तस्मादर्केष्टिमान्सुतः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मान्मार्तंडवत्सलः ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him was born his son Arkeṣṭimat.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Mārtaṇḍavatsala.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mihirārthastu tatsutaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādaruṇapoṣaṇaḥ .. 13 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं मिहिरार्थस्तु तत्सुतः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादरुणपोषणः ॥ 13 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Mihirārtha.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Aruṇapoṣaṇa.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāddyumaṇivatsalaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāttaraṇiyajñakaḥ .. 14 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्द्युमणिवत्सलः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मात्तरणियज्ञकः ॥ 14 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Dyumaṇivatsala.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Taraṇiyajñaka.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmānmaitreṣṭivardhanaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ citrabhānūrjakastataḥ .. ..' 15 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मान्मैत्रेष्टिवर्धनः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं चित्रभानूर्जकस्ततः ॥ ॥' 15 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Maitreṣṭivardhana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]. After him came Citrabhānūrjaka.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvairocanaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ haṃsanyāyī tu tatsutaḥ .. 16 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वैरोचनः स्मृतः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं हंसन्यायी तु तत्सुतः ॥ 16 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him is remembered Vairocana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Haṃsanyāyin.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvedapravardhanaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmātsāvitra ucyate .. 17 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वेदप्रवर्धनः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मात्सावित्र उच्यते ॥ 17 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled equal to his father; from him came Vedapravardhana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him is named Sāvitra.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhanapālastato'bhavat ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ mlecchahantā sutaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 18 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं धनपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
शतहीनं कृत राज्यं म्लेच्छहन्ता सुतः स्मृतः ॥ 18 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; after him came Dhanapāla.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son is remembered as Mlecchahantṛ.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādānaṃdavarddhanaḥ ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dharmapālasutastataḥ .. 19 ..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादानंदवर्द्धनः ॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं धर्मपालसुतस्ततः ॥ 19 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; from him came Ānandavardhana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; after him came the son of Dharmapāla.

3.1.s:
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ brahmabhakta sutastataḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādbrahmeṣṭivarddhanaḥ..3.1.3.20..
3.1.d:
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं ब्रह्मभक्त सुतस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्ब्रह्मेष्टिवर्द्धनः॥3.1.3.20॥
3.1.m:
He ruled less a hundred [years]; after him was his son Brahmabhakta.
He ruled equal to his father; from him came Brahmeṣṭivardhana.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādātmaprapūjakaḥ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ parameṣṭhī sutastataḥ..21..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादात्मप्रपूजकः॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं परमेष्ठी सुतस्ततः॥21॥
3.1.m:
He ruled equal to his father; from him came Ātmaprapūjaka.
He ruled equal to his father; after him was his son Parameṣṭhin.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāddhairaṇyavarddhanaḥ..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhātṛyājī tu tatsutaḥ..22..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्धैरण्यवर्द्धनः॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं धातृयाजी तु तत्सुतः॥22॥
3.1.m:
He ruled equal to his father; from him came Dhairaṇyavardhana.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Dhātṛyājin.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tadvidhātṛprapūjakaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvai druhiṇaḥ kratuḥ .. 23 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तद्विधातृप्रपूजकः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वै द्रुहिणः क्रतुः ॥ 23 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled equal to his father, that Vidhātṛprapūjaka.
He ruled equal to his father; from him indeed came Druhiṇakratu.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvairañcya ucyate..
śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tatputraḥ kamalāsanaḥ .. 24 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वैरञ्च्य उच्यते॥
शतहीनं कृतं राज्यं तत्पुत्रः कमलासनः ॥ 24 ॥
3.1.m:
He ruled equal to his father; from him is named Vairañcya.
He ruled less a hundred [years]; his son was Kamalāsana.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śamavartī tu tatsutaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājya śrāddhadevastu tatsutaḥ ..25..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शमवर्ती तु तत्सुतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्य श्राद्धदेवस्तु तत्सुतः ॥25॥
3.1.m: His son Śamavartin ruled equal to his father. / His son Śrāddhadeva ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvai pitṛvarddhanaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ somadattastu tatsutaḥ .. 26 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वै पितृवर्द्धनः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सोमदत्तस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 26 ॥
3.1.m: Therefore indeed Pitṛvardhana ruled equal to his father. / His son Somadatta ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ saumadattistadātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādvai somavarddhanaḥ .. 27 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सौमदत्तिस्तदात्मजः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माद्वै सोमवर्द्धनः ॥ 27 ॥
3.1.m: His son Saumadatti ruled equal to his father. / Therefore indeed Somavardhana ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamavataṃsaḥ sutastataḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ prataṃsastanayastataḥ .. 28 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमवतंसः सुतस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं प्रतंसस्तनयस्ततः ॥ 28 ॥
3.1.m: Then his son Avataṃsa ruled equal to his father. / Then his son Prataṃsa ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ parātaṃsastadātmajaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamayataṃsastato'bhavat .. 29 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं परातंसस्तदात्मजः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमयतंसस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 29 ॥
3.1.m: His son Parātaṃsa ruled equal to his father. / Then Ayataṃsa was born and ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛta rājyaṃ samātaṃsastu tatsutaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamanutaṃsastadātmajaḥ .. 3.1.3.30 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृत राज्यं समातंसस्तु तत्सुतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमनुतंसस्तदात्मजः ॥ 3.1.3.30 ॥
3.1.m: His son Samātaṃsa ruled equal to his father. / His son Anutaṃsa ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamadhitaṃsastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamabhitaṃsastadātmajaḥ ... .. 31 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमधितंसस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमभितंसस्तदात्मजः ॥॥। 31 ॥
3.1.m: Then Adhitaṃsa was born and ruled equal to his father. / His son Abhitaṃsa ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ samuttaṃsastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ taṃsonāma suto'bhavat .. 32 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं समुत्तंसस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तंसोनाम सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.1.m: Then Samuttaṃsa was born and ruled equal to his father. / Then a son named Taṃsa was born and ruled equal to his father.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ duṣyaṃtastanayastataḥ ..
śakuṃtalāyāṃ tasmācca bharato nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 33 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं दुष्यंतस्तनयस्ततः ॥
शकुंतलायां तस्माच्च भरतो नाम भूपतिः ॥ 33 ॥
3.1.m: Then his son Duṣyanta ruled equal to his father. / And from him by Śakuntalā the king named Bharata [was born].

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ duṣyaṃtaḥ svargatiṃ gataḥ ..
bharatonāma tatputro devapūjana tatparaḥ .. 34 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं दुष्यंतः स्वर्गतिं गतः ॥
भरतोनाम तत्पुत्रो देवपूजन तत्परः ॥ 34 ॥
3.1.m: Having ruled equal to his father, Duṣyanta went to heaven. / His son named Bharata was devoted to worshipping the gods.

3.1.s:
mahāmāyāprabhāvena ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṣajīvanam ..
ṣaṭtriṃśābdasahasrāṇi nṛpāyurvarddhitaṃ tathā .. 35 ..
3.1.d:
महामायाप्रभावेन षट्त्रिंशद्वर्षजीवनम् ॥
षट्त्रिंशाब्दसहस्राणि नृपायुर्वर्द्धितं तथा ॥ 35 ॥
3.1.m: By the power of Mahāmāyā, [his] lifespan of thirty-six years / was increased so that the king's lifespan was thirty-six thousand years.

3.1.s:
tasya nāmnā smṛtaḥ khaṃḍo bhārato nāma viśrutaḥ ..
tena bhūmervibhāgaśca kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ pṛthak ciram .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
तस्य नाम्ना स्मृतः खंडो भारतो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
तेन भूमेर्विभागश्च कृतं राज्यं पृथक् चिरम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: After his name, the continent is remembered as famed Bhārata. / By him, division of the land was made, and an independent kingdom ruled for a long time.

3.1.s:
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto mahābalaḥ ..
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājyaṃ bharadvājastato'bhavat .. 37 ..
3.1.d:
दिव्यं वर्षशतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो महाबलः ॥
दिव्यं वर्षशतं राज्यं भरद्वाजस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled for a hundred divine years; from him was born one of great strength. / Then Bharadvāja was born and ruled for a hundred divine years.

3.1.s:
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājyaṃ tasmādbhavanamanyumān ..
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi samā rājyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 38 ..
3.1.d:
दिव्यं वर्षशतं राज्यं तस्माद्भवनमन्युमान् ॥
अष्टादशसहस्राणि समा राज्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.1.m: The kingdom was ruled for a hundred divine years; from him [came] Bhavanmanyu. / His reign is proclaimed to have been eighteen thousand years.

3.1.s:
bṛhatkṣetrastato hyāsītpitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
suhotrastanayastasya pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 39 ..
3.1.d:
बृहत्क्षेत्रस्ततो ह्यासीत्पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
सुहोत्रस्तनयस्तस्य पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 39 ॥
3.1.m: Then indeed Bṛhatkṣetra was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / His son Suhotra held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
vītihotrastasya suto rājyaṃ daśasahasrakam ..
yajñahotrastato'pyāsītpitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 3.1.3.40 ..
3.1.d:
वीतिहोत्रस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं दशसहस्रकम् ॥
यज्ञहोत्रस्ततोऽप्यासीत्पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 3.1.3.40 ॥
3.1.m: His son Vītihotra ruled for ten thousand [years]. / Then also Yajñahotra was born; he held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
śakrahotrastato jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
prasanno bhagavāniṃdrastaṃ nṛpaṃ svargamāptavān .. 41 ..
3.1.d:
शक्रहोत्रस्ततो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
प्रसन्नो भगवानिंद्रस्तं नृपं स्वर्गमाप्तवान् ॥ 41 ॥
3.1.m: From him Śakrahotra was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / Lord Indra, being pleased, took that king to heaven.

3.1.s:
tadāyodhyāpatiḥ śrīmānpratāpeṃdro mahābalaḥ ..
bhārataṃ varṣamadadhadvarṣaṃ daśasahasrakam .. 42 ..
3.1.d:
तदायोध्यापतिः श्रीमान्प्रतापेंद्रो महाबलः ॥
भारतं वर्षमदधद्वर्षं दशसहस्रकम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.1.m: Then the illustrious lord of Ayodhyā, Pratāpendra, of great strength, / held the land of Bhārata for ten thousand years.

3.1.s:
maṃḍalīkastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
vijayeṃdrastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 43 ..
3.1.d:
मंडलीकस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
विजयेंद्रस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.1.m: His son Maṇḍalīka held a position equal to his father's. / His son Vijayendra held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
dhanurdīptastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
iṃdrājñayā śakrahotro ghṛtācyā saha bhūtale .. 44 ...
3.1.d:
धनुर्दीप्तस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
इंद्राज्ञया शक्रहोत्रो घृताच्या सह भूतले ॥ 44 ॥।
3.1.m: His son Dhanurdīpta held a position equal to his father's. / By the command of Indra, Śakrahotra with Ghṛtācī, upon the earth,

3.1.s:
prāptāvānsadhanurdīptaṃ jitvā rājyamacīkarat ..
hastīnāma suto jāta airāvatasutaṃ gajam .. 45 ..
3.1.d:
प्राप्तावान्सधनुर्दीप्तं जित्वा राज्यमचीकरत् ॥
हस्तीनाम सुतो जात ऐरावतसुतं गजम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.1.m: arrived, conquered that Dhanurdīpta, and ruled the kingdom. / A son named Hastin was born; mounting an elephant,

3.1.s:
āruhya paścime deśe hastinānagarī kṛtā ..
daśayojanavistīrṇā svargaṃgāyāstaṭe śubhā .. 46 ..
3.1.d:
आरुह्य पश्चिमे देशे हस्तिनानगरी कृता ॥
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णा स्वर्गंगायास्तटे शुभा ॥ 46 ॥
3.1.m: a son of Airāvata, he founded the city of Hastinā in the western region, / ten yojanas in extent, auspicious, on the bank of the heavenly Gaṅgā.

3.1.s:
rājyaṃ daśasahasraṃ ca tatra vāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
tatputrastvajamīḍhākhyaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 47 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यं दशसहस्रं च तत्र वासं चकार सः ॥
तत्पुत्रस्त्वजमीढाख्यः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.1.m: He dwelt there and ruled for ten thousand [years]. / And his son named Ajamīḍha held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmājāto rakṣapālaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
suśamyarṇastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 48 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माजातो रक्षपालः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
सुशम्यर्णस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.1.m: From him Rakṣapāla was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / His son Suśamyarṇa held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasya putraḥ kururnāma piturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
iṃdrasya varadānena sadehaḥ svargamāgataḥ .. 49 ..
3.1.d:
तस्य पुत्रः कुरुर्नाम पितुरर्द्धं कृतं पदम् ॥
इंद्रस्य वरदानेन सदेहः स्वर्गमागतः ॥ 49 ॥
3.1.m: His son was named Kuru; he held a position equal to half of his father's. / By the granting of a boon by Indra, he went to heaven with his body.

3.1.s:
tadā sāttvatavaṃśe'sminvṛṣṇirnāma mahābalaḥ ..
mathurāyāṃ sthito rājyaṃ sarvaṃ svavaśamāptavān .. 3.1.3.50 ..
3.1.d:
तदा सात्त्वतवंशेऽस्मिन्वृष्णिर्नाम महाबलः ॥
मथुरायां स्थितो राज्यं सर्वं स्ववशमाप्तवान् ॥ 3.1.3.50 ॥
3.1.m: Then in this Sāttvata lineage, the mighty Vṛṣṇi, / residing in Mathurā, brought the entire kingdom under his control.

3.1.s:
bhagavato varadānena hareradbhutakarmaṇaḥ ..
paṃcavarṣasahasraṃ ca sarvaṃ rājyaṃ vaśīkṛtam .. 51 ..
3.1.d:
भगवतो वरदानेन हरेरद्भुतकर्मणः ॥
पंचवर्षसहस्रं च सर्वं राज्यं वशीकृतम् ॥ 51 ॥
3.1.m: By the granting of a boon by Lord Hari of miraculous deeds, / the whole kingdom was held under control for five thousand years.

3.1.s:
nirāvṛttistasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
daśārī tasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 52 ..
3.1.d:
निरावृत्तिस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
दशारी तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.1.m: His son Nirāvṛtti held a position equal to his father's. / His son Daśārī held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
viyāmunastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
jīmūtastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 53 ..
3.1.d:
वियामुनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
जीमूतस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.1.m: His son Viyāmuna held a position equal to his father's. / His son Jīmūta held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
vikṛtistasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājjāto bhīmarathaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 54 ..
3.1.d:
विकृतिस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्माज्जातो भीमरथः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 54 ॥
3.1.m: His son Vikṛti held a position equal to his father's. / From him Bhīmaratha was born; he held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmājjāto navarathaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājjāto daśarathaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 55 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातो नवरथः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्माज्जातो दशरथः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 55 ॥
3.1.m: From him Navaratha was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / From him Daśaratha was born; he held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmājjātaśca śakuniḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājjātaḥ kuśuṃbhaśca pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 56 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातश्च शकुनिः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्माज्जातः कुशुंभश्च पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.1.m: And from him Śakuni was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / And from him Kuśumbha was born; he held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmājjāto devarathaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
devakṣetrastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 57 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातो देवरथः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
देवक्षेत्रस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.1.m: From him Devaratha was born; he held a position equal to his father's. / His son Devakṣetra held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasya putro madhurnāma pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tato navarathaḥ putraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 58 ..
3.1.d:
तस्य पुत्रो मधुर्नाम पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
ततो नवरथः पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.1.m: His son named Madhu held a position equal to his father's. / Then his son Navaratha held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
kuruvatsasta sya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmādanurathaḥ putraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 59 ..
3.1.d:
कुरुवत्सस्त स्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्मादनुरथः पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.1.m: His son Kuruvatsa held a position equal to his father's. / From him [his] son Anuratha held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
puruhotraḥ sutastasya pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
vicitrāṅgastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..3.1.3.60..
3.1.d:
पुरुहोत्रः सुतस्तस्य पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
विचित्राङ्गस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥3.1.3.60॥
3.1.m: His son Puruhotra held a position equal to his father's. / His son Vicitrāṅga held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmātsātvatavānputraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
bhajamānastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 61 ..
3.1.d:
तस्मात्सात्वतवान्पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
भजमानस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.1.m: From him [his] son Sātvatavat held a position equal to his father's. / His son Bhajamāna held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
vidūrathastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
surabhaktastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 62 ..
3.1.d:
विदूरथस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
सुरभक्तस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.1.m: His son Vidūratha held a position equal to his father's. / His son Surabhakta held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmācca sumanāḥ putraḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam..
tatikṣetrastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 63 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माच्च सुमनाः पुत्रः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम्॥
ततिक्षेत्रस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.1.m: And from him [his] son Sumanas held a position equal to his father's. / His son Tatikṣetra held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
svāyaṃbhuvastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛṃtaṃ padam ..
haridīpaka evāsau tasya rājyaṃ pitussa mama .. 64 ..
3.1.d:
स्वायंभुवस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृंतं पदम् ॥
हरिदीपक एवासौ तस्य राज्यं पितुस्स मम ॥ 64 ॥
3.1.m: His son Svāyambhuva held a position equal to his father's. / He was indeed Haridīpaka; his kingdom was equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
devamedhāssutastasya pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
surapālastadā jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 65 ..
3.1.d:
देवमेधास्सुतस्तस्य पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
सुरपालस्तदा जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 65 ॥
3.1.m: His son Devamedhas held a position equal to his father's. / Then Surapāla was born; he held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
śakrājñayā kuruścaiva dvāpara tritaye pade ..
vyatīte ca sukeśyāssa svarveśyāyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ .. 66 ..
3.1.d:
शक्राज्ञया कुरुश्चैव द्वापर त्रितये पदे ॥
व्यतीते च सुकेश्यास्स स्वर्वेश्यायाः पतिः प्रभुः ॥ 66 ॥
3.1.m: By Indra's order, Kuru, when the three parts of Dvāpara had passed, / the lord, husband of Sukeśī, the heavenly courtesan,

3.1.s:
āgato bhārate khaṃḍe kurukṣetraṃ tadā kṛtam ..
viṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ puṇya kṣetraṃ smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ .. 67 ..
3.1.d:
आगतो भारते खंडे कुरुक्षेत्रं तदा कृतम् ॥
विंशद्योजनविस्तीर्णं पुण्य क्षेत्रं स्मृतं बुधैः ॥ 67 ॥
3.1.m: came to the continent of Bhārata; then Kurukṣetra was established, / twenty yojanas in extent, considered a sacred land by the wise.

3.1.s:
dvādaśābdasahasraṃ ca kuruṇā rājyasātkṛtam ..
tasmājjahnussuto jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 68 ..
3.1.d:
द्वादशाब्दसहस्रं च कुरुणा राज्यसात्कृतम् ॥
तस्माज्जह्नुस्सुतो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.1.m:
And for twelve thousand years the kingdom was ruled by Kuru.
From him Jahnu was born as a son, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmācca suratho jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
vidūrathastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 69..
3.1.d:
तस्माच्च सुरथो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
विदूरथस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 69॥
3.1.m:
And from him Suratha was born, who held a position equal to his father's.
Vidūratha was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
sārvabhaumastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
jayasenastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 3.1.3.70 ..
3.1.d:
सार्वभौमस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
जयसेनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 3.1.3.70 ॥
3.1.m:
Sārvabhauma was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.
Jayasena was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmādarṇava evāsau pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
catussāgaragāmī ca pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 71 ..
3.1.d:
तस्मादर्णव एवासौ पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
चतुस्सागरगामी च पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.1.m:
From him came Arṇava, who held a position equal to his father's;
and Catussāgaragāmin, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
ayutāyustasya suto rājyaṃ daśasahasrakam..
akrodhanastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam..72..
3.1.d:
अयुतायुस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं दशसहस्रकम्॥
अक्रोधनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम्॥72॥
3.1.m:
Ayutāyus was his son; his reign was ten thousand [years].
Akrodhana was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
tasmādṛkṣassuto jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam..
bhīmasenastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 73 ..
3.1.d:
तस्मादृक्षस्सुतो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम्॥
भीमसेनस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 73 ॥
3.1.m:
From him Ṛkṣa was born as a son, who held a position equal to his father's.
Bhīmasena was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.

3.1.s:
dilīpastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
pratīpastasya tanayo rājyaṃ paṃcasahasrakam .. .. 74 ..
3.1.d:
दिलीपस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
प्रतीपस्तस्य तनयो राज्यं पंचसहस्रकम् ॥ ॥ 74 ॥
3.1.m:
Dilīpa was his son, who held a position equal to his father's.
Pratīpa was his son; his reign was five thousand [years].

3.1.s:
śaṃtanustasya putraśca rājyamekasahasrakam ..
vicitravīryastatputro rājyaṃ vai dviśataṃ samāḥ .. 75 ..
3.1.d:
शंतनुस्तस्य पुत्रश्च राज्यमेकसहस्रकम् ॥
विचित्रवीर्यस्तत्पुत्रो राज्यं वै द्विशतं समाः ॥ 75 ॥
3.1.m:
Śaṃtanu was his son; his reign was one thousand [years].
Vicitravīrya was his son; his reign was indeed two hundred years.

3.1.s:
pāṃḍuśca tanayo yasminrājyaṃ paṃcaśataṃ kṛtam ..
yudhiṣṭhirastasya suto rājyaṃ paṃcāśadabdakam .. 76 ..
3.1.d:
पांडुश्च तनयो यस्मिन्राज्यं पंचशतं कृतम् ॥
युधिष्ठिरस्तस्य सुतो राज्यं पंचाशदब्दकम् ॥ 76 ॥
3.1.m:
And Pāṇḍu was the son during whose time a reign of five hundred [years] was conducted.
Yudhiṣṭhira was his son; his reign was fifty years.

3.1.s:
suyodhanena ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tataḥ param ..
yudhiṣṭhireṇa nidhanaṃ tasya prāptaṃ kurusthale .. 77 ..
3.1.d:
सुयोधनेन षष्ट्यब्दं कृतं राज्यं ततः परम् ॥
युधिष्ठिरेण निधनं तस्य प्राप्तं कुरुस्थले ॥ 77 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign of sixty years was conducted thereafter by Suyodhana.
His death was brought about by Yudhiṣṭhira on the field of Kuru.

3.1.s:
pūrvaṃ devāsure yuddhe ye daityāśca surairhatāḥ ..
te sarve śaṃtano rājye janmavaṃtaḥ pratasthire .. 78 ..
3.1.d:
पूर्वं देवासुरे युद्धे ये दैत्याश्च सुरैर्हताः ॥
ते सर्वे शंतनो राज्ये जन्मवंतः प्रतस्थिरे ॥ 78 ॥
3.1.m:
The Daityas who were slain formerly by the gods in the battle between gods and asuras,
all of them took birth and set forth during Śaṃtanu's reign.

3.1.s:
lakṣamakṣauhiṇī teṣāṃ tadbhāreṇa vasundharā ..
śakrasya śaraṇaṃ prāptāvatāraṃ ca tato hareḥ .. 79 ..
3.1.d:
लक्षमक्षौहिणी तेषां तद्भारेण वसुन्धरा ॥
शक्रस्य शरणं प्राप्तावतारं च ततो हरेः ॥ 79 ॥
3.1.m:
Their [forces numbered] a hundred thousand akṣauhiṇīs; burdened by that weight, the earth
took refuge with Śakra, and from that came the incarnation of Hari.

3.1.s:
sa śaurervasudevasya devakyāṃ janmanāviśat ..
evaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāvīryo rohiṇīnilayaṃ gataḥ .. 3.1.3.80 ..
3.1.d:
स शौरेर्वसुदेवस्य देवक्यां जन्मनाविशत् ॥
एवं कृष्णो महावीर्यो रोहिणीनिलयं गतः ॥ 3.1.3.80 ॥
3.1.m:
He entered [earth] by birth from Śūri's son Vasudeva in Devakī.
Thus Kṛṣṇa of great prowess went to Rohiṇī's abode.

3.1.s:
paṃcatriṃśaduttaraṃ ca śataṃ varṣaṃ ca bhūtale ..
uṣitvā kṛṣṇacandraśca tato golokamāgataḥ .. 81 ..
3.1.d:
पंचत्रिंशदुत्तरं च शतं वर्षं च भूतले ॥
उषित्वा कृष्णचन्द्रश्च ततो गोलोकमागतः ॥ 81 ॥
3.1.m:
Having dwelt on the surface of the earth for one hundred and thirty-five years,
Kṛṣṇacandra then went to Goloka.

3.1.s:
caturthacaraṇānte ca harerjanma smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ ..
hastināpuramadhyasyābhimanyostanayastataḥ .. 82 ..
3.1.d:
चतुर्थचरणान्ते च हरेर्जन्म स्मृतं बुधैः ॥
हस्तिनापुरमध्यस्याभिमन्योस्तनयस्ततः ॥ 82 ॥
3.1.m:
The birth of Hari is remembered by the wise [to have occurred] at the end of the fourth quarter.
Then the son of Abhimanyu, residing in the midst of Hastināpura,

3.1.s:
rājyamekasahasraṃ ca tato'bhūjjanamejayaḥ ..
trisahasraṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śatānīkastato'bhavat .. 83 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यमेकसहस्रं च ततोऽभूज्जनमेजयः ॥
त्रिसहस्रं कृतं राज्यं शतानीकस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 83 ॥
3.1.m:
[ruled for] a reign of one thousand [years]; after him came Janamejaya.
A reign of three thousand [years] was conducted; then came Śatānīka.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ yajñadattastataḥ sutaḥ ..
rājyaṃ paṃcasahasraṃ ca niścakrastanayo'bhavat .. 84 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं यज्ञदत्तस्ततः सुतः ॥
राज्यं पंचसहस्रं च निश्चक्रस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 84 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came his son Yajñadatta.
A reign of five thousand [years was his], and Niścakra became his son.

3.1.s:
sahasramekaṃ rājyaṃ taduṣṭrapālastato'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmāccitrarathassutaḥ .. 85 ..
3.1.d:
सहस्रमेकं राज्यं तदुष्ट्रपालस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माच्चित्ररथस्सुतः ॥ 85 ॥
3.1.m:
His reign was one thousand [years]; then came Uṣṭrapāla.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him came the son Citraratha.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ dhṛtimāṃstanayastataḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ suṣeṇastanayo'bhavat .. 86 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं धृतिमांस्तनयस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुषेणस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 86 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came his son Dhṛtimat.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Suṣeṇa became his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sunīthastanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ makhapālaḥ suto'bhavat .. 87 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुनीथस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मखपालः सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 87 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Sunītha became his son.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Makhapāla became his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ na cakṣustanayastataḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sukhavaṃtastato'bhavat .. 88 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं न चक्षुस्तनयस्ततः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुखवंतस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 88 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came his son Nacakṣus.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came Sukhavat.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmātpāriplavassutaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sunayastatsuto'bhavat .. 89 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्मात्पारिप्लवस्सुतः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं सुनयस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥ 89 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him came the son Pāriplava.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Sunaya became his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ medhāvī tatsuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto nṛpaṃjayaḥ .. 3.1.3.90 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मेधावी तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो नृपंजयः ॥ 3.1.3.90 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Medhāvin became his son.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him was born Nṛpañjaya.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mṛdustattanayo'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tigmajyotistu tatsutaḥ .. 91 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं मृदुस्तत्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तिग्मज्योतिस्तु तत्सुतः ॥ 91 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Mṛdu became his son.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; but his son was Tigmajyotis.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto bṛhadrathaḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vasudānastato'bhavat ..92..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो बृहद्रथः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं वसुदानस्ततोऽभवत् ॥92॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him was born Bṛhadratha.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came Vasudāna.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śatānīkastato'bhavat..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmādudyāna ucyate .. 93 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शतानीकस्ततोऽभवत्॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्मादुद्यान उच्यते ॥ 93 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; then came Śatānīka.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him is named Udyāna.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmājjāto hyahīnaraḥ ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ nirmitrastanayo'bhavat .. 94 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं तस्माज्जातो ह्यहीनरः ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं निर्मित्रस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 94 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; from him Ahīnara indeed was born.
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Nirmitra became his son.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kṣemakastatsuto'bhavat ..
rājyaṃ tyaktvā sa medhāvī kalāpagrāmamāśritaḥ .. 95 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं क्षेमकस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
राज्यं त्यक्त्वा स मेधावी कलापग्राममाश्रितः ॥ 95 ॥
3.1.m:
A reign equal to his father's was conducted; Kṣemaka became his son.
Abandoning the kingdom, that wise one took refuge in the village of Kalāpa.

3.1.s:
mlecchaiśca maraṇaṃ prāpto yamalokamato gataḥ ..
nāradasyopadeśena pradyotastanayastataḥ .. 96 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छैश्च मरणं प्राप्तो यमलोकमतो गतः ॥
नारदस्योपदेशेन प्रद्योतस्तनयस्ततः ॥ 96 ॥
3.1.m:
Meeting his death at the hands of the mlecchas, he went from there to the realm of Yama.
Then, through the instruction of Nārada, his son Pradyota

3.1.s:
mlecchayajñaḥ kṛtastena mlecchā hananamāgatāḥ .. .. 97 .. ..
dvāparayugabhūpākhyānavarṇanam
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छयज्ञः कृतस्तेन म्लेच्छा हननमागताः ॥ ॥ 97 ॥ ॥
द्वापरयुगभूपाख्यानवर्णनम्
3.1.m:
performed a mleccha sacrifice, and the mlecchas met destruction.
Account of the Kings of the Dvāpara Age.

3.1.s:
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ yajñaḥ kṛtastena pradyotena vicakṣaṇa ..
sarvaṃ kathaya me tāta trikālajña mahāmune .. 1 ..
3.1.d:
॥ शौनक उवाच ॥ ॥
कथं यज्ञः कृतस्तेन प्रद्योतेन विचक्षण ॥
सर्वं कथय मे तात त्रिकालज्ञ महामुने ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m:
Śaunaka said:
How was the sacrifice performed by that Pradyota, O wise one?
Tell me everything, father, O great sage who knows past, present, and future.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekadā hastinagare pradyotaḥ kṣemakātmajaḥ ..
āsthitaḥ sa kathāmadhye nārado'bhyāgamattadā .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
एकदा हस्तिनगरे प्रद्योतः क्षेमकात्मजः ॥
आस्थितः स कथामध्ये नारदोऽभ्यागमत्तदा ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m:
Sūta said:
Once in the city of Hasti, while Pradyota, son of Kṣemaka,
was seated in the midst of an assembly, Nārada arrived at that time.

3.1.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣito rājā pūjayāmāsa dharmavit ..
sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sa muniḥ pradyotaṃ nṛpamabravīt .. 3 ..
3.1.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा हर्षितो राजा पूजयामास धर्मवित् ॥
सुखोपविष्टः स मुनिः प्रद्योतं नृपमब्रवीत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.1.m:
Seeing him, the joyful king, knower of dharma, worshipped him.
Seated comfortably, that sage spoke to King Pradyota:

3.1.s:
mlecchairhatastava pitā yamalokamato gataḥ ..
mlecchayajñaprabhāveṇa svargatirbhavitā hi saḥ ..4..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छैर्हतस्तव पिता यमलोकमतो गतः ॥
म्लेच्छयज्ञप्रभावेण स्वर्गतिर्भविता हि सः ॥4॥
3.1.m:
“Your father was slain by mlecchas and has gone from there to the realm of Yama;
by the power of a mleccha sacrifice, he shall indeed attain heaven.”

3.1.s:
tacchrutvā krodhatāmrākṣo brāhmaṇānvedavittamān ..
āhūya sa kurukṣetre mlecchayajñaṃ samārabhat .. 5 ..
3.1.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षो ब्राह्मणान्वेदवित्तमान् ॥
आहूय स कुरुक्षेत्रे म्लेच्छयज्ञं समारभत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.1.m:
Hearing that, his eyes copper-red with anger, he summoned
brāhmaṇas most learned in the Veda and began the mleccha sacrifice at Kurukṣetra.

3.1.s:
yajñakuṃḍaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ yojanānyeva ṣoḍaśa ..
racitvā devatā dhyātvā mlecchāṃśca juhuyānnṛpaḥ .. 6 ..
3.1.d:
यज्ञकुंडं चतुष्कोणं योजनान्येव षोडश ॥
रचित्वा देवता ध्यात्वा म्लेच्छांश्च जुहुयान्नृपः ॥ 6 ॥
3.1.m:
Having fashioned a four-cornered sacrificial pit sixteen yojanas in size,
and having meditated upon the deities, the king offered the mlecchas into the fire:

3.1.s:
hārahūṇānbarbarāṃśca guruṃḍāṃśca śakānkhasān ..
yavanānpallavāṃścaiva romajānkharasaṃbhavān .. 7 ..
3.1.d:
हारहूणान्बर्बरांश्च गुरुंडांश्च शकान्खसान् ॥
यवनान्पल्लवांश्चैव रोमजान्खरसंभवान् ॥ 7 ॥
3.1.m:
the Hārahūṇas, the Barbaras, the Guruṇḍas, the Śakas, the Khasas,
the Yavanas, the Pallavas, those born in Rome, those born of donkeys,

3.1.s:
dvīpa sthitānkāmarūśca cīnānsāgaramadhyagān..
prāhūya bhasmasātkurvanvedamaṃtraprabhāvataḥ .. 8 ..
3.1.d:
द्वीप स्थितान्कामरूश्च चीनान्सागरमध्यगान्॥
प्राहूय भस्मसात्कुर्वन्वेदमंत्रप्रभावतः ॥ 8 ॥
3.1.m:
the Kāmarūs dwelling on islands, and the Chinese situated in the midst of the sea—
summoning them and reducing them to ash through the power of Vedic mantras.

3.1.s:
brāhmaṇāndakṣiṇāṃ dattvā abhiṣekamakārayat ..
kṣemako nāma nṛpatiḥ svargalokaṃ tato gataḥ .. 9 ..
3.1.d:
ब्राह्मणान्दक्षिणां दत्त्वा अभिषेकमकारयत् ॥
क्षेमको नाम नृपतिः स्वर्गलोकं ततो गतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.1.m:
Having given dakṣiṇā to the brāhmaṇas, he had the royal consecration performed.
Then the king named Kṣemaka went to the world of heaven.

3.1.s:
mlecchahaṃtā nāma tasya vikhyātaṃ bhuvi sarvataḥ ..
rājyaṃ daśasahasrābdaṃ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā .. 3.1.4.10 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छहंता नाम तस्य विख्यातं भुवि सर्वतः ॥
राज्यं दशसहस्राब्दं कृतं तेन महात्मना ॥ 3.1.4.10 ॥
3.1.m:
His name, ‘Slayer of the Mlecchas,’ became renowned everywhere on earth.
A reign of ten thousand years was conducted by that great-souled one.

3.1.s:
svargalokaṃ gato rājā tatputro vedavānsmṛtaḥ..
dvisahasraṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tadā mlecchaḥ kaliḥ svayam ..
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayitvā divyāṃ stutimathākarot .. .. 11 ..
3.1.d:
स्वर्गलोकं गतो राजा तत्पुत्रो वेदवान्स्मृतः॥
द्विसहस्रं कृतं राज्यं तदा म्लेच्छः कलिः स्वयम् ॥
नारायणं पूजयित्वा दिव्यां स्तुतिमथाकरोत् ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
3.1.m:
The king went to the heavenly world; his son is remembered as Vedavat.
A reign of two thousand [years] was conducted; then the mleccha Kali himself,
having worshipped Nārāyaṇa, made a divine hymn of praise.

3.1.s:
.. kaliruvāca .. ..
namo'naṃtāya mahate sarvakālapravartine .. 12 ..
3.1.d:
॥ कलिरुवाच ॥ ॥
नमोऽनंताय महते सर्वकालप्रवर्तिने ॥ 12 ॥
3.1.m:
Kali said:
Homage to the infinite, the great one, who sets all time in motion!

3.1.s:
caturyugakṛte tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe ..
daśāvatārāya hare namastubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ..13..
3.1.d:
चतुर्युगकृते तुभ्यं वासुदेवाय साक्षिणे ॥
दशावताराय हरे नमस्तुभ्यं नमोनमः ॥13॥
3.1.m: Praise to you, the maker of the four yugas, to Vāsudeva, the witness! / Praise to you, the ten-incarnation Hari, praise, praise to you!

3.1.s:
namaḥ śaktyavatārāya rāmakṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ..
namo matsyāvatārāya mahate gauravāsine .. 14 ..
3.1.d:
नमः शक्त्यवताराय रामकृष्णाय ते नमः ॥
नमो मत्स्यावताराय महते गौरवासिने ॥ 14 ॥
3.1.m: Praise to your power-incarnation; praise to you, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa! / Praise to your fish-incarnation, the great one, the dweller in splendour!

3.1.s:
namo bhaktāvatārāya kalpakṣetranivāsine ..
rājñā vedavatā nātha mama sthānaṃ vināśitam ..
mama priyasya mlecchasya tatpitrā vaṃśanāśanam .. 15 ..
3.1.d:
नमो भक्तावताराय कल्पक्षेत्रनिवासिने ॥
राज्ञा वेदवता नाथ मम स्थानं विनाशितम् ॥
मम प्रियस्य म्लेच्छस्य तत्पित्रा वंशनाशनम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.1.m: Praise to your devotee-incarnation, the dweller in the Kalpa-field! / Lord, my place has been destroyed by King Vedavat; / by his father the lineage of my dear mleccha was destroyed.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti stutastu kalinā mlecchasya saha bhāryayā ..16..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इति स्तुतस्तु कलिना म्लेच्छस्य सह भार्यया ॥16॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / Thus praised by Kali, together with his wife,

3.1.s:
prāptavānsa hariḥ sākṣādbhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ ..
kaliṃ provāca sa hariryuṣmadarthe yugottamam .. 17 ..
3.1.d:
प्राप्तवान्स हरिः साक्षाद्भगवान्भक्तवत्सलः ॥
कलिं प्रोवाच स हरिर्युष्मदर्थे युगोत्तमम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.1.m: that Lord Hari, who loves his devotees, appeared in person. / That Hari said to Kali: "For your sake, the best of yugas,

3.1.s:
bahurūpamahaṃ kṛtvā tavecchāṃ pūrayāmyaham ..
ādamo nāma puruṣaḥ patnī havyavatī tathā .. 18 ..
3.1.d:
बहुरूपमहं कृत्वा तवेच्छां पूरयाम्यहम् ॥
आदमो नाम पुरुषः पत्नी हव्यवती तथा ॥ 18 ॥
3.1.m: assuming many forms, I shall fulfil your desire. / A man named Ādama and likewise his wife Havyavatī,

3.1.s:
viṣṇukardamato jātau .mlecchavaṃśapravardhanau ..
haristvantardadhe tatra kalirānaṃdasaṃkulaḥ .. 19 ..
3.1.d:
विष्णुकर्दमतो जातौ ।म्लेच्छवंशप्रवर्धनौ ॥
हरिस्त्वन्तर्दधे तत्र कलिरानंदसंकुलः ॥ 19 ॥
3.1.m: born from Viṣṇu's mud, will increase the mleccha lineage." / Then Hari vanished, and Kali was filled with joy.

3.1.s:
giriṃ nīlācalaṃ prāpya kiṃcitkālamavāsayat ..
putro vedavato jātaḥ sunaṃdo nāma bhūpatiḥ .. 3.1.4.20 ..
3.1.d:
गिरिं नीलाचलं प्राप्य किंचित्कालमवासयत् ॥
पुत्रो वेदवतो जातः सुनंदो नाम भूपतिः ॥ 3.1.4.20 ॥
3.1.m: Having reached the Nīlācala mountain, he dwelt there for some time. / A son was born to Vedavat, a king named Sunanda.

3.1.s:
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamanapatyo mṛtiṃ gataḥ ..
āryadeśāḥ kṣīṇavaṃto mlecchavaṃśā balānvitāḥ .. 21 ..
3.1.d:
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यमनपत्यो मृतिं गतः ॥
आर्यदेशाः क्षीणवंतो म्लेच्छवंशा बलान्विताः ॥ 21 ॥
3.1.m: He ruled the kingdom just like his father; he died childless. / The Āryan lands will dwindle, and the mleccha lineages, endowed with strength,

3.1.s:
bhaviṣyaṃti bhṛguśreṣṭha tasmācca tuhinācalam ..
gatvā viṣṇuṃ samārādhya gamiṣyāmo hareḥ padam .. 22 ..
3.1.d:
भविष्यंति भृगुश्रेष्ठ तस्माच्च तुहिनाचलम् ॥
गत्वा विष्णुं समाराध्य गमिष्यामो हरेः पदम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.1.m: will arise, O best of the Bhṛgus. Therefore, going to the snowy mountain / and worshipping Viṣṇu, we shall go to Hari’s abode.

3.1.s:
iti śrutvā dvijāḥ sarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi gatāste tuhinācalam .. 23 .. ..
3.1.d:
इति श्रुत्वा द्विजाः सर्वे नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ॥
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि गतास्ते तुहिनाचलम् ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
3.1.m: Hearing this, all the twice-born dwelling in the Naimiṣa forest, / eighty-eight thousand of them, went to the snowy mountain.

3.1.s:
viśālāyāṃ samāsādya viṣṇugāthāṃ pracakṣire ..
iti vyāsena kathitaṃ vākyaṃ kaliviśāradam ..
śrotāraṃ sa manaḥ kṛtvā bhaviṣyaṃ samudīrayat .. 24 ..
3.1.d:
विशालायां समासाद्य विष्णुगाथां प्रचक्षिरे ॥
इति व्यासेन कथितं वाक्यं कलिविशारदम् ॥
श्रोतारं स मनः कृत्वा भविष्यं समुदीरयत् ॥ 24 ॥
3.1.m: Arriving at Viśālā, they recited the story of Viṣṇu. / Thus Vyāsa spoke this discourse knowing the Kali age. / Making his mind the listener, he narrated the future.

3.1.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
manaḥ śṛṇu tato gāthāṃ bhāvī sūtena varṇitām ..
kaleryugasya pūrṇāṃ tāṃ tacchrutvā tṛptimāvaha .. 25 .. ..
3.1.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
मनः शृणु ततो गाथां भावी सूतेन वर्णिताम् ॥
कलेर्युगस्य पूर्णां तां तच्छ्रुत्वा तृप्तिमावह ॥ 25 ॥ ॥
3.1.m: Vyāsa said: / O mind, hear from there the future story recounted by Sūta, / fully complete for the Kali yuga; hearing it, attain satisfaction.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ṣoḍaśābdasahasre ca śeṣe taddvāpare yuge ..
bahukīrtimatī bhūmirāryadeśasya kīrtitā ..26..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
षोडशाब्दसहस्रे च शेषे तद्द्वापरे युगे ॥
बहुकीर्तिमती भूमिरार्यदेशस्य कीर्तिता ॥26॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / When sixteen thousand years remained in that Dvāpara yuga, / the land of the Āryan country was praised as possessing great fame.

3.1.s:
kvacidviprāḥ smṛtā bhūpāḥ kvacidrājanyavaṃśajāḥ ..
kvacidvaiśyāḥ kvacicchūdrāḥ kutracidvarṇasaṃkarāḥ..27..
3.1.d:
क्वचिद्विप्राः स्मृता भूपाः क्वचिद्राजन्यवंशजाः ॥
क्वचिद्वैश्याः क्वचिच्छूद्राः कुत्रचिद्वर्णसंकराः॥27॥
3.1.m: In some places brahmins were known as kings, in some those born of royal lineage, / in some vaiśyas, in some śūdras, and somewhere those of mixed classes.

3.1.s:
dviśatāṣṭasahasre dve śeṣe tu dvāpare yuge ..
mlecchadeśasya yābhūmirbhavitā kīrtimālinī .. 28 ..
3.1.d:
द्विशताष्टसहस्रे द्वे शेषे तु द्वापरे युगे ॥
म्लेच्छदेशस्य याभूमिर्भविता कीर्तिमालिनी ॥ 28 ॥
3.1.m: When two thousand two hundred and eight [years] remained in the Dvāpara yuga, / the land of the mleccha country will become renowned for fame.

3.1.s:
iṃdriyāṇi damitvā yo hyātmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
tasmādādamanāmāsau patnī havyavatī smṛtā .. 29 ..
3.1.d:
इंद्रियाणि दमित्वा यो ह्यात्मध्यानपरायणः ॥
तस्मादादमनामासौ पत्नी हव्यवती स्मृता ॥ 29 ॥
3.1.m: Because he subdued his senses and was devoted to meditation on the Self, / he was named Ādama, and his wife was known as Havyavatī.

3.1.s:
pradānanagarasyaiva pūrvabhāge mahāvanam ..
īśvareṇa kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ catuḥkrośāyataṃ smṛtam .. 3.1.4.30 ..
3.1.d:
प्रदाननगरस्यैव पूर्वभागे महावनम् ॥
ईश्वरेण कृतं रम्यं चतुःक्रोशायतं स्मृतम् ॥ 3.1.4.30 ॥
3.1.m: In the eastern part of the city of Pradāna, a great forest, / lovely, extending four krosas, was made by the Lord.

3.1.s:
pāpavṛkṣatale gatvā patnīdarśanatatparaḥ ..
kalistatrāgatastūrṇaṃ sarparūpaṃ hi tatkṛtam.. .. 31 ..
3.1.d:
पापवृक्षतले गत्वा पत्नीदर्शनतत्परः ॥
कलिस्तत्रागतस्तूर्णं सर्परूपं हि तत्कृतम्॥ ॥ 31 ॥
3.1.m: Having gone beneath the tree of sin, eager to see his wife, / Kali quickly arrived there, having taken the form of a serpent.

3.1.s:
vaṃcitā tena dhūrtena viṣṇvājñā bhaṃgatāṃ gatā ..
khāditvā tatphalaṃ ramyaṃ lokamārgapradaṃ patiḥ .. 32 ..
3.1.d:
वंचिता तेन धूर्तेन विष्ण्वाज्ञा भंगतां गता ॥
खादित्वा तत्फलं रम्यं लोकमार्गप्रदं पतिः ॥ 32 ॥
3.1.m: Deceived by that rogue, the command of Viṣṇu was broken. / Having eaten that delightful fruit which shows the worldly way, the husband,

3.1.s:
uduṃbarasya patraiśca tābhyāṃ vāyvaśanaṃ kṛtam ..
sutāḥ putrāstato jātāḥ sarve mlecchā babhūvire .. 33 ..
3.1.d:
उदुंबरस्य पत्रैश्च ताभ्यां वाय्वशनं कृतम् ॥
सुताः पुत्रास्ततो जाताः सर्वे म्लेच्छा बभूविरे ॥ 33 ॥
3.1.m: along with [his wife], lived on air and [clothed themselves] with leaves of the udumbara tree. / Sons and daughters were born from him; they all became mlecchas.

3.1.s:
triṃśottaraṃ navaśataṃ tasyāyuḥ parikīrtitam ..
phalānāṃ havanaṃ kurvanpatnyā saha divaṃ gataḥ .. 34 ..
3.1.d:
त्रिंशोत्तरं नवशतं तस्यायुः परिकीर्तितम् ॥
फलानां हवनं कुर्वन्पत्न्या सह दिवं गतः ॥ 34 ॥
3.1.m: His lifespan is proclaimed as nine hundred and thirty [years]. / Offering oblation of fruits, he went to heaven together with his wife.

3.1.s:
tasmājjātaḥ sutaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śvetanāmeti viśrutaḥ ..
dvādaśottaravarṣaṃ ca tasyāyuḥ parikīrtitam .. 35 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातः सुतः श्रेष्ठः श्वेतनामेति विश्रुतः ॥
द्वादशोत्तरवर्षं च तस्यायुः परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.1.m: From him was born an excellent son, renowned by the name Śveta. / His lifespan is proclaimed as [nine hundred and] twelve years.

3.1.s:
anuhastasya tanayaḥ śatahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
kīnāśastasya tanayaḥ pitāmahasamaṃ padam .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
अनुहस्तस्य तनयः शतहीनं कृतं पदम् ॥
