कीनाशस्तस्य तनयः पितामहसमं पदम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: Anuhasta was his son; he held the position for a hundred [years] less. / Kīnāśa was his son; his position was equal to his grandfather's.

3.1.s:
mahallalastasya sutaḥ paṃcahīnaṃ śataṃ nava ..
tena rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra tasmānmānagaraṃ smṛtam .. 37 ..
3.1.d:
महल्ललस्तस्य सुतः पंचहीनं शतं नव ॥
तेन राज्यं कृतं तत्र तस्मान्मानगरं स्मृतम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: Mahallala was his son; [his lifespan was] nine hundred minus five [years]. / He ruled the kingdom there; therefore the city of Mā was remembered.

3.1.s:
tasmācca virado jāto rājyaṃ ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ samāḥ ..
jñeyaṃ navaśataṃ tasya svanāmnā nagaraṃ kṛtam .. 38 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माच्च विरदो जातो राज्यं षष्ट्युत्तरं समाः ॥
ज्ञेयं नवशतं तस्य स्वनाम्ना नगरं कृतम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.1.m: From him was born Virada; his reign should be known / as nine hundred and sixty years; he built a city after his own name.

3.1.s:
hanūkastasya tanayo viṣṇu bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
phalānāṃ havanaṃ kurvaṃstattvaṃ hyasi jayansadā..39..
3.1.d:
हनूकस्तस्य तनयो विष्णु भक्तिपरायणः ॥
फलानां हवनं कुर्वंस्तत्त्वं ह्यसि जयन्सदा॥39॥
3.1.m: Hanūka was his son, devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu, / offering oblations of fruits, continually conquering with [the mantra] "You are the Reality".

3.1.s:
triśataṃ paṃcaṣaṣṭiśca rājyaṃ varṣāṇi tatsmṛtam ..
sadehaḥ svargamāyāto mlecchadharmaparāyaṇaḥ..3.1.4.40..
3.1.d:
त्रिशतं पंचषष्टिश्च राज्यं वर्षाणि तत्स्मृतम् ॥
सदेहः स्वर्गमायातो म्लेच्छधर्मपरायणः॥3.1.4.40॥
3.1.m: His reign is remembered as three hundred and sixty-five years. / Devoted to the dharma of the mlecchas, he went to heaven with his physical body.

3.1.s:
ācāraśca vivekaśca dvijatā devapūjanam..
kṛtānyetāni tenaiva tasmānmlecchaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ ..41..
3.1.d:
आचारश्च विवेकश्च द्विजता देवपूजनम्॥
कृतान्येतानि तेनैव तस्मान्म्लेच्छः स्मृतो बुधैः ॥41॥
3.1.m: Good conduct, discernment, twice-born status, and the worship of the gods / were performed by him alone; therefore he was regarded as a mleccha by the wise.

3.1.s:
viṣṇubhaktyagnipūjā ca hyahiṃsā ca tapo damaḥ ..
dharmāṇyetāni munibhirmlecchānāṃ hi smṛtāni vai .. 42 ..
3.1.d:
विष्णुभक्त्यग्निपूजा च ह्यहिंसा च तपो दमः ॥
धर्माण्येतानि मुनिभिर्म्लेच्छानां हि स्मृतानि वै ॥ 42 ॥
3.1.m: Devotion to Viṣṇu, fire worship, non-violence, asceticism, and self-restraint: / these are indeed regarded by the sages as the duties of the mlecchas.

3.1.s:
matocchilastasya suto hanukasyaiva bhārgava..
rājyaṃ navaśataṃ tasya saptatiśca smṛtāḥ samāḥ ..43..
3.1.d:
मतोच्छिलस्तस्य सुतो हनुकस्यैव भार्गव॥
राज्यं नवशतं तस्य सप्ततिश्च स्मृताः समाः ॥43॥
3.1.m: Matocchila was his son, [born] to Hanūka, O Bhārgava; / his reign is remembered as nine hundred and seventy years.

3.1.s:
lomakastasya tanayo rājyaṃ saptaśataṃ samāḥ ..
saptasaptatirevāsya tatpaścātsvargatiṃ gataḥ ..44..
3.1.d:
लोमकस्तस्य तनयो राज्यं सप्तशतं समाः ॥
सप्तसप्ततिरेवास्य तत्पश्चात्स्वर्गतिं गतः ॥44॥
3.1.m: Lomaka was his son; his reign was seven hundred / and seventy-seven years; after that he attained heaven.

3.1.s:
tasmājjātaḥ suto nyūho nirgatastūha eva saḥ ..
tasmānnyūhaḥ smṛtaḥ prājñai rājyaṃ paṃcaśataṃ kṛtam .. 45 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातः सुतो न्यूहो निर्गतस्तूह एव सः ॥
तस्मान्न्यूहः स्मृतः प्राज्ञै राज्यं पंचशतं कृतम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.1.m: From him was born a son, Nyūha; he had gone beyond reasoning (ūha), / therefore he was called Nyūha by the wise; he ruled for five hundred [years].

3.1.s:
sīmaḥ śamaśca bhāvaśca trayaḥ putrā babhūvire ..
nyūhaḥ smṛto viṣṇubhaktasso'haṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 46 ..
3.1.d:
सीमः शमश्च भावश्च त्रयः पुत्रा बभूविरे ॥
न्यूहः स्मृतो विष्णुभक्तस्सोऽहं ध्यानपरायणः ॥ 46 ॥
3.1.m: Sīma, Śama, and Bhāva were his three sons. / Nyūha is remembered as a devotee of Viṣṇu, devoted to meditation on "I am He".

3.1.s: ekadā bhagavānviṣṇustatsvapne tu samāgataḥ .. 47 ..
3.1.d: एकदा भगवान्विष्णुस्तत्स्वप्ने तु समागतः ॥ 47 ॥
3.1.m: Once, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu appeared in his dream:

3.1.s:
vatsa nyūha śṛṇuṣvedaṃ pralayaḥ saptame'hani ..
bhavitā tvaṃ janaissārdhaṃ nāvamāruhya satvaram .. 48 ..
3.1.d:
वत्स न्यूह शृणुष्वेदं प्रलयः सप्तमेऽहनि ॥
भविता त्वं जनैस्सार्धं नावमारुह्य सत्वरम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.1.m: "Child Nyūha, hear this: on the seventh day the dissolution / will take place. Boarding a boat quickly together with your people,

3.1.s:
jīvanaṃ kuru bhakteṣu sarvaśreṣṭho bhaviṣyasi ..
tatheti matvā sa munirnāvaṃ kṛtvā supuṣṭitām .. 49 ..
3.1.d:
जीवनं कुरु भक्तेषु सर्वश्रेष्ठो भविष्यसि ॥
तथेति मत्वा स मुनिर्नावं कृत्वा सुपुष्टिताम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.1.m: preserve your life; you will become the foremost among devotees." / Saying "So be it", that sage made a very sturdy boat,

3.1.s:
hastatriśatalambāṃ ca paṃcāśaddhastavistṛtām ..
triṃśaddhastocchritāṃ ramyāṃ sarvajīvasamanvitām .. 3.1.4.50 ..
3.1.d:
हस्तत्रिशतलम्बां च पंचाशद्धस्तविस्तृताम् ॥
त्रिंशद्धस्तोच्छ्रितां रम्यां सर्वजीवसमन्विताम् ॥ 3.1.4.50 ॥
3.1.m: three hundred cubits in length, fifty cubits in breadth, / thirty cubits high, lovely, supplied with all living creatures.

3.1.s:
āruhya svakulaissārddhaṃ viṣṇudhyānaparo'bhavat ..
sāṃvartako meghagaṇo maheṃdreṇa samanvitaḥ .. 51 ..
3.1.d:
आरुह्य स्वकुलैस्सार्द्धं विष्णुध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥
सांवर्तको मेघगणो महेंद्रेण समन्वितः ॥ 51 ॥
3.1.m: Having boarded it with his family, he became absorbed in meditation on Viṣṇu. / Accompanied by Mahendra, the Sāṁvartaka clouds

3.1.s:
catvāriṃśaddinānyeva mahāvṛṣṭimakārayat ..
sarvaṃ tu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ jalaiḥ plāvya tu siṃdhavaḥ .. 52 ..
3.1.d:
चत्वारिंशद्दिनान्येव महावृष्टिमकारयत् ॥
सर्वं तु भारतं वर्षं जलैः प्लाव्य तु सिंधवः ॥ 52 ॥
3.1.m: caused a great rain for forty days. / Flooding the whole land of Bhārata with waters, the oceans,

3.1.s:
catvāro militāḥ sarve viśālāyāṃ na cāgatāḥ ..
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munayo brahmavādinaḥ .. 53 ..
3.1.d:
चत्वारो मिलिताः सर्वे विशालायां न चागताः ॥
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥ 53 ॥
3.1.m: all four united, but they did not reach Viśālā. / Eighty-eight thousand sages who expound the Veda,

3.1.s:
nyūhaśca svakulaissārdhaṃ śeṣāssarve vināśitāḥ ..
tadā ca munayassarve viṣṇumāyāṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ .. 54 ..
3.1.d:
न्यूहश्च स्वकुलैस्सार्धं शेषास्सर्वे विनाशिताः ॥
तदा च मुनयस्सर्वे विष्णुमायां प्रतुष्टुवुः ॥ 54 ॥
3.1.m: and Nyūha with his family [survived]; all the rest were destroyed. / And then all the sages praised the illusory power of Viṣṇu.

3.1.s:
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
namo devyai mahākālyai devakyai ca namonamaḥ ..
mahālakṣmyai viṣṇumātre rādhā devyai namonamaḥ .. 55 ..
3.1.d:
॥ मुनय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
नमो देव्यै महाकाल्यै देवक्यै च नमोनमः ॥
महालक्ष्म्यै विष्णुमात्रे राधा देव्यै नमोनमः ॥ 55 ॥
3.1.m: The sages said: / Praise to the Goddess Mahākālī, and praise, praise to Devakī! / Praise to Mahālakṣmī, the mother of Viṣṇu; praise, praise to goddess Rādhā!

3.1.s:
revatyai puṣpavatyai ca svarṇavatyai namonamaḥ ..
kāmākṣāyai ca māyāyai namo mātre namonamaḥ .. 56 ..
3.1.d:
रेवत्यै पुष्पवत्यै च स्वर्णवत्यै नमोनमः ॥
कामाक्षायै च मायायै नमो मात्रे नमोनमः ॥ 56 ॥
3.1.m: Homage, homage to Revatī, to Puṣpavatī, and to Svarṇavatī; / homage to Kāmākṣī and to Māyā, homage, homage to the Mother.

3.1.s:
mahāvātaprabhāvena mahā megharaveṇa ca ..
jaladhārābhirugrābhirbhayaṃ jātaṃ hi dāruṇam ..57..
3.1.d:
महावातप्रभावेन महा मेघरवेण च ॥
जलधाराभिरुग्राभिर्भयं जातं हि दारुणम् ॥57॥
3.1.m: Through the power of a mighty wind and through the roar of great clouds, / [and] by the fierce streams of water, a dreadful terror indeed arose.

3.1.s:
tasmādbhayādbhairavi tvamasmānsaṃrakṣa kiṃkarān ..
tadā prasannā sā devī jalaṃ śāṃta tayā kṛtam .. 58 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माद्भयाद्भैरवि त्वमस्मान्संरक्ष किंकरान् ॥
तदा प्रसन्ना सा देवी जलं शांत तया कृतम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.1.m: Protect us, your servants, O Bhairavī, from that terror! / Then that goddess was pleased; the water was pacified by her.

3.1.s:
abdāṃtare mahī sarvā sthalī bhūtvā pradṛśyate ..
ārācca śiṣiṇā nāma himādrestaṭabhūmayaḥ .. 59 ..
3.1.d:
अब्दांतरे मही सर्वा स्थली भूत्वा प्रदृश्यते ॥
आराच्च शिषिणा नाम हिमाद्रेस्तटभूमयः ॥ 59 ॥
3.1.m: Within a year, the whole earth appeared as dry land; / and nearby was named Śiṣiṇā, the shore-lands of the snowy mountain.

3.1.s:
nyūhastatra sthito nāvamāruhya svakulaissaha ..
jalāṃte bhūmimāgatya tatra vāsaṃ karoti saḥ .. 3.1.4.60 ..
kaliyugabhūpākhyānavarṇanam
3.1.d:
न्यूहस्तत्र स्थितो नावमारुह्य स्वकुलैस्सह ॥
जलांते भूमिमागत्य तत्र वासं करोति सः ॥ 3.1.4.60 ॥
कलियुगभूपाख्यानवर्णनम्
3.1.m:
Nyūha stayed there, having boarded the boat together with his family; / when the waters ended, having reached land, he dwelt there.
Description of the narrative of the kings of the Kali age

3.1.s:
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ vartate yo vai pralayāṃte munīśvara ..
divyadṛṣṭiprabhāvena jñātaṃ brūhi tataḥ param .. 1 ..
3.1.d:
॥ शौनक उवाच ॥ ॥
सांप्रतं वर्तते यो वै प्रलयांते मुनीश्वर ॥
दिव्यदृष्टिप्रभावेन ज्ञातं ब्रूहि ततः परम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m: Śaunaka said: / O lord of sages, tell [us] beyond that what has been known by the power of divine vision / concerning whoever exists at present after the dissolution.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nyūho nāma smṛto mleccho viṣṇumohaṃ tadākarot ..
tadā prasanno bhagavāṃstasya vaṃśaḥ pravarddhitaḥ ..2..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
न्यूहो नाम स्मृतो म्लेच्छो विष्णुमोहं तदाकरोत् ॥
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तस्य वंशः प्रवर्द्धितः ॥2॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / The mleccha named Nyūha then performed devotion to Viṣṇu; / then the Blessed One was pleased, [and] his lineage increased.

3.1.s:
mlecchabhāṣā kṛtā tena vedavākyaparāṅmukhā ..
kaleśca vṛddhaye brāhmīṃ bhāṣāṃ kṛtvā'paśabdagām ... 3 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छभाषा कृता तेन वेदवाक्यपराङ्मुखा ॥
कलेश्च वृद्धये ब्राह्मीं भाषां कृत्वाऽपशब्दगाम् ॥। 3 ॥
3.1.m: A mleccha language turned away from the words of the Veda was made by him; / and having turned the sacred language into corrupt speech for the growth of the Kali [age],

3.1.s:
nyūhāya dattavāndevo buddhīśo buddhigaḥ svayam ..
vilomaṃ ca kṛtaṃ nāma nyūhena trisutasya vai .. 4 ..
3.1.d:
न्यूहाय दत्तवान्देवो बुद्धीशो बुद्धिगः स्वयम् ॥
विलोमं च कृतं नाम न्यूहेन त्रिसुतस्य वै ॥ 4 ॥
3.1.m: the god himself, the lord of intellect who abides in intellect, gave it to Nyūha. / And reverse names were indeed made by Nyūha for his three sons:

3.1.s:
simaśca hāmaśca tathā yākūto nāma viśrutaḥ ..
yākūtaḥ saptaputraśca jumro mājūja eva saḥ ..5..
3.1.d:
सिमश्च हामश्च तथा याकूतो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
याकूतः सप्तपुत्रश्च जुम्रो माजूज एव सः ॥5॥
3.1.m: Sima and Hāma, and the renowned one named Yākūta. / And Yākūta had seven sons: Jumra, and that very Mājūja,

3.1.s:
mādī tathā ca yūnānastūvalomasakastathā ..
tīrāsaśca tathā teṣāṃ nāmabhirdeśa ucyate ..6..
3.1.d:
मादी तथा च यूनानस्तूवलोमसकस्तथा ॥
तीरासश्च तथा तेषां नामभिर्देश उच्यते ॥6॥
3.1.m: Mādī, and likewise Yūnāna, Tūvala, Masaka, / and likewise Tīrāsa; lands are named after their names.

3.1.s:
jumrā daśa kanābjaśca riphataśca tajarrumaḥ ..
tannāmnā ca smṛtā deśā yūnādyā ye sutāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
3.1.d:
जुम्रा दश कनाब्जश्च रिफतश्च तजर्रुमः ॥
तन्नाम्ना च स्मृता देशा यूनाद्या ये सुताः स्मृताः ॥ 7 ॥
3.1.m: From Jumra were Kanābja, Riphata, and Tajarruma; / and lands are named after their names; those who are remembered as sons from Yūna onwards

3.1.s:
ilīśastaralīśaśca kittīhūdānirucyate ..
caturbhirnāmabhirdeśāsteṣāṃ teṣāṃ pracakrire .. .. 8 ..
3.1.d:
इलीशस्तरलीशश्च कित्तीहूदानिरुच्यते ॥
चतुर्भिर्नामभिर्देशास्तेषां तेषां प्रचक्रिरे ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
3.1.m: are called Ilīśa, Taralīśa, and Kittīhūdāni; / regions were designated for each of them after their four names.

3.1.s:
dvitīyatanayāddhāmātsutāścatvāra eva te ..
kuśo miśraśca kūjaśca kanaāṃstatra nāmabhiḥ .. 9 ..
3.1.d:
द्वितीयतनयाद्धामात्सुताश्चत्वार एव ते ॥
कुशो मिश्रश्च कूजश्च कनआंस्तत्र नामभिः ॥ 9 ॥
3.1.m: From the second son, Hāma, there were four sons indeed: / Kuśa, Miśra, Kūja, and Kanaāṃ; by their names

3.1.s:
deśāḥ prasiddhā mlecchānāṃ kuśātṣaṭtanayāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
sa vā caiva havīlaśca sarvatoragamastathā .. 3.1.5.10 ..
3.1.d:
देशाः प्रसिद्धा म्लेच्छानां कुशात्षट्तनयाः स्मृताः ॥
स वा चैव हवीलश्च सर्वतोरगमस्तथा ॥ 3.1.5.10 ॥
3.1.m: renowned lands of the mlecchas [are known]. Six sons are remembered from Kuśa: / Savā, Havīla, and Sarvatoragama,

3.1.s:
tathā savatikā nāma nimarūho mahābalaḥ ..
teṣāṃ putrāśca kalanaḥ siṃnāroraka ucyate .. 11 ..
3.1.d:
तथा सवतिका नाम निमरूहो महाबलः ॥
तेषां पुत्राश्च कलनः सिंनारोरक उच्यते ॥ 11 ॥
3.1.m: and the one named Savatikā, and the mighty Nimarūha. / And their sons are called Kalana, Siṃnāra, and Uraka,

3.1.s:
akkado vāvunaścaiva rasanādeśakāśca te ..
śrāvayitvā munīnsūto yoganidrāvaśaṃ gataḥ .. 12 ..
3.1.d:
अक्कदो वावुनश्चैव रसनादेशकाश्च ते ॥
श्रावयित्वा मुनीन्सूतो योगनिद्रावशं गतः ॥ 12 ॥
3.1.m: and Akkada, Vāvuna, and Rasanādeśaka. / Having recited [this] to the sages, the Sūta succumbed to the power of yogic sleep.

3.1.s:
dvisahasre śatābdānte buddhvā punarathābravīta ..
simavaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi simo jyeṣṭhaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ .. 13 ..
3.1.d:
द्विसहस्रे शताब्दान्ते बुद्ध्वा पुनरथाब्रवीत ॥
सिमवंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि सिमो ज्येष्ठः स भूपतिः ॥ 13 ॥
3.1.m: Awakening at the end of two thousand and one hundred years, he then spoke again: / I shall describe the lineage of Sima. Sima was the eldest, a king.

3.1.s:
rājyaṃ paṃcaśataṃ varṣaṃ tena mlecchena satkṛtam ..
arkansadastasya sutaścatustriṃśacca rājyakam .. 14 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यं पंचशतं वर्षं तेन म्लेच्छेन सत्कृतम् ॥
अर्कन्सदस्तस्य सुतश्चतुस्त्रिंशच्च राज्यकम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.1.m: A reign of five hundred years was upheld by that mleccha; / Arkansada was his son, and [his] kingdom was thirty-four [years].

3.1.s:
catuśśataṃ punarjñeyaṃ siṃhastattanayo'bhavat ..
rājyaṃ tasya smṛtaṃ tatra ṣaṣṭyuttara catuḥ śatam .. 15 ..
3.1.d:
चतुश्शतं पुनर्ज्ञेयं सिंहस्तत्तनयोऽभवत् ॥
राज्यं तस्य स्मृतं तत्र षष्ट्युत्तर चतुः शतम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.1.m: Four hundred [years] more should be known; Siṃha became his son; / his reign there is remembered as four hundred and sixty [years].

3.1.s:
ivratasya suto jñeyaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
phalajastasya tanayaścatvāriṃśaddvayaṃ śatam .. 16 ..
3.1.d:
इव्रतस्य सुतो ज्ञेयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
फलजस्तस्य तनयश्चत्वारिंशद्द्वयं शतम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.1.m: The son of Ivrata should be known to have held the status equal to his father; / Phalaja was his son; two hundred and forty [years]

3.1.s:
rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ tu tasmācca raū nāma sutaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
saptatriṃśacca dviśataṃ tasya rājyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 17 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यं कृतं तु तस्माच्च रऊ नाम सुतः स्मृतः ॥
सप्तत्रिंशच्च द्विशतं तस्य राज्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.1.m: was the rule made [by him]; and from him a son named Raū is remembered; / two hundred and thirty-seven [years] is proclaimed as his reign.

3.1.s:
tasmācca jūja utpannaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
nahūrastasya tanayo vayaḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ śatam ..
rājyaṃ cakāra nṛpatirbahuśatrūnvihiṃsayan .. 18 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माच्च जूज उत्पन्नः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
नहूरस्तस्य तनयो वयः षष्ट्युत्तरं शतम् ॥
राज्यं चकार नृपतिर्बहुशत्रून्विहिंसयन् ॥ 18 ॥
3.1.m: And from him Jūja was born; he held the status equal to his father; / Nahūra was his son; his life was one hundred and sixty [years]; / destroying many enemies, the king ruled.

3.1.s:
tāharastasya tanayaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmātputro'virāmaśca nahūro hāranastrayaḥ .. 19..
3.1.d:
ताहरस्तस्य तनयः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्मात्पुत्रोऽविरामश्च नहूरो हारनस्त्रयः ॥ 19॥
3.1.m: Tāhara was his son; he held the status equal to his father; / from him came three sons: Avirāma, Nahūra, and Hārana.

3.1.s:
evaṃ teṣāṃ smṛtā vaṃśā nāmamātreṇa kīrtitāḥ ..
sarasvatyāśca śāpena mlecchabhāṣā mahādhamāḥ .. 3.1.5.20 ..
3.1.d:
एवं तेषां स्मृता वंशा नाममात्रेण कीर्तिताः ॥
सरस्वत्याश्च शापेन म्लेच्छभाषा महाधमाः ॥ 3.1.5.20 ॥
3.1.m: Thus their lineages are remembered, proclaimed by mere name; / and by the curse of Sarasvatī, the most degraded mleccha languages [arose].

3.1.s:
teṣāṃ vṛddhiḥ kalau cāsītsaṃkṣepeṇa prakīrtitā ..
saṃskṛtasyaiva vāṇī tu bhārataṃ varṣamūhyatām .. 21 ..
3.1.d:
तेषां वृद्धिः कलौ चासीत्संक्षेपेण प्रकीर्तिता ॥
संस्कृतस्यैव वाणी तु भारतं वर्षमूह्यताम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.1.m: Their growth occurred in the Kali age, proclaimed in brief; / let the speech of Sanskrit alone be considered as [belonging to] the realm of Bhārata.

3.1.s:
anyakhaṃḍe gatā saiva mlecchā hyānaṃdino'bhavan ..
evaṃ te vipra kathitaṃ viṣṇubhaktadvijaissaha .. 22 .. ..
3.1.d:
अन्यखंडे गता सैव म्लेच्छा ह्यानंदिनोऽभवन् ॥
एवं ते विप्र कथितं विष्णुभक्तद्विजैस्सह ॥ 22 ॥ ॥
3.1.m: When that same [speech] went to other lands, the mlecchas indeed became joyful; / thus has it been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, along with the twice-born devotees of Viṣṇu.

3.1.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā munayassarve viśālāyāṃ nivāsinaḥ ..
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjya vinayānvitāḥ ..23..
3.1.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनयस्सर्वे विशालायां निवासिनः ॥
नरं नारायणं देवं संपूज्य विनयान्विताः ॥23॥
3.1.m: Vyāsa said: / Having heard that, all the sages dwelling in Viśālā, / having worshipped the god Nara-Nārāyaṇa with modesty,

3.1.s:
dhyānaṃ cakrurmudā yuktā dviśataṃ parivatsarān ..
tatpaścādbodhitāssarve śaunakādyā munīśvarāḥ .. 24 ..
3.1.d:
ध्यानं चक्रुर्मुदा युक्ता द्विशतं परिवत्सरान् ॥
तत्पश्चाद्बोधितास्सर्वे शौनकाद्या मुनीश्वराः ॥ 24 ॥
3.1.m: meditated with joy for two hundred years. / Afterwards, all the great sages Śaunaka and the others, having awakened,

3.1.s:
saṃdhyātarpaṇadevārcāḥ kṛtvā dhyātvā janārddanam ..
lomaharṣaṇamāsīnaṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ .. 25 ..
3.1.d:
संध्यातर्पणदेवार्चाः कृत्वा ध्यात्वा जनार्द्दनम् ॥
लोमहर्षणमासीनं पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः ॥ 25 ॥
3.1.m: having performed the twilight prayers, water-libations, and deity worship, and having meditated on Janārdana, / asked Lomaharṣaṇa who was seated, filled with humility:

3.1.s:
vyāsaśiṣya mahābhāga ciraṃ jīva mahāmate ..
sāṃprataṃ vartate yo vai rājā tanme vada prabho .. 26 ..
3.1.d:
व्यासशिष्य महाभाग चिरं जीव महामते ॥
सांप्रतं वर्तते यो वै राजा तन्मे वद प्रभो ॥ 26 ॥
3.1.m: O disciple of Vyāsa, highly fortunate, live long, O highly wise one! / Tell me, O lord, who indeed is the king who exists at present?

3.1.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
trisahasrābdasaṃprāpte kalau bhārgavanaṃdana ..
āvante śaṃkhanāmā'sau sāṃprataṃ vartate nṛpaḥ ..27..
3.1.d:
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
त्रिसहस्राब्दसंप्राप्ते कलौ भार्गवनंदन ॥
आवन्ते शंखनामाऽसौ सांप्रतं वर्तते नृपः ॥27॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / When three thousand years have arrived in the Kali [age], O son of Bhṛgu, / that king named Śaṅkha exists at present in Avanti.

3.1.s:
mlecchadeśe śakapatiratha rājyaṃ karoti vai ..
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ sarve yathā yasya vivardhanam .. 28 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छदेशे शकपतिरथ राज्यं करोति वै ॥
शृणु तत्कारणं सर्वे यथा यस्य विवर्धनम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.1.m: Now in the mleccha land the lord of the Śakas indeed rules; / all of you listen to the reason for that, how each experienced growth.

3.1.s:
dvisahasre kalau prāpte mlecchavaṃśavivarddhitā ..
bhūmirmlecchamayī sarvā nānāpathavivarddhitā..29..
3.1.d:
द्विसहस्रे कलौ प्राप्ते म्लेच्छवंशविवर्द्धिता ॥
भूमिर्म्लेच्छमयी सर्वा नानापथविवर्द्धिता॥29॥
3.1.m: When two thousand [years] arrived in the Kali [age], the earth was multiplied by lineages of mlecchas; / it was all full of mlecchas, expanded with diverse doctrines,

3.1.s:
brahmāvartamṛte tatra sarasvatyāstaṭaṃ śubham ..
mlecchācāryaśca mūśākhyastanmataiḥ pūritaṃ jagat .. 3.1.5.30 ..
3.1.d:
ब्रह्मावर्तमृते तत्र सरस्वत्यास्तटं शुभम् ॥
म्लेच्छाचार्यश्च मूशाख्यस्तन्मतैः पूरितं जगत् ॥ 3.1.5.30 ॥
3.1.m: except Brahmāvarta, there on the auspicious bank of the Sarasvatī. / And there was a mleccha teacher named Mūśā; the world was filled with his teachings.

3.1.s:
devārcanaṃ vedabhāṣā naṣṭā prāpte kalau yuge ..
tallakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu mune mlecchabhāṣāścaturvidhāḥ .. 31..
3.1.d:
देवार्चनं वेदभाषा नष्टा प्राप्ते कलौ युगे ॥
तल्लक्षणं शृणु मुने म्लेच्छभाषाश्चतुर्विधाः ॥ 31॥
3.1.m: Deity worship and the Vedic language were lost when the Kali age arrived. / Hear their characteristic features, O sage; the mleccha languages are of four types:

3.1.s:
vrajabhāṣā mahārāṣṭrī yāvanī ca guruṃḍikā ..
tāsāṃ caturlakṣavidhā bhāṣāścānyāstathaiva ca .. ..32..
3.1.d:
व्रजभाषा महाराष्ट्री यावनी च गुरुंडिका ॥
तासां चतुर्लक्षविधा भाषाश्चान्यास्तथैव च ॥ ॥32॥
3.1.m: Vrajabhāṣā, Mahārāṣṭrī, Yāvanī, and Guruṇḍikā; / and of these there are four hundred thousand varieties, as well as other languages.

3.1.s:
pānīyaṃ ca smṛtaṃ pānī bubhukṣā bhūkha ucyate ..
pānīyaṃ pāpaḍī bhāṣā bhojanaṃ kakkanaṃ smṛtam ..33..
3.1.d:
पानीयं च स्मृतं पानी बुभुक्षा भूख उच्यते ॥
पानीयं पापडी भाषा भोजनं कक्कनं स्मृतम् ॥33॥
3.1.m: Pānīya is remembered as pānī; bubhukṣā is called bhūkha; / pānīya is the speech pāpaḍī; bhojana is remembered as kakkana.

3.1.s:
iṣṭiśuddharavaḥ prokta istinī masapāvanī
āhutirvai āju iti dadāti ca dadhāti ca .. 34 ..
3.1.d:
इष्टिशुद्धरवः प्रोक्त इस्तिनी मसपावनी
आहुतिर्वै आजु इति ददाति च दधाति च ॥ 34 ॥
3.1.m: Iṣṭi is spoken of as the pure sound istinī, purifying the flesh; / an oblation (āhuti) is āju, and 'gives' (dadāti) and 'places' (dadhāti).

3.1.s:
pitṛpaitarabhrātā ca bādaraḥ patireva ca ..
seti sā yāvanī bhāṣā hyaśvaścāspastathā punaḥ..35..
3.1.d:
पितृपैतरभ्राता च बादरः पतिरेव च ॥
सेति सा यावनी भाषा ह्यश्वश्चास्पस्तथा पुनः॥35॥
3.1.m: Pitṛ is paitara, and bhrātā is bādara and pati; / such is that Yāvanī language, and horse (aśva) is aspa;

3.1.s:
jānusthāne jainuśabdaḥ saptasiṃdhustathaiva ca ..
saptahinduryāvanī ca punarjñeyā guruṃḍikā .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
जानुस्थाने जैनुशब्दः सप्तसिंधुस्तथैव च ॥
सप्तहिन्दुर्यावनी च पुनर्ज्ञेया गुरुंडिका ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: in place of jānu is the word jainu, and likewise saptasindhu / is saptahindu in Yāvanī; and Guruṇḍikā should further be known.

3.1.s:
ravivāre ca saṃḍe ca phālgune caiva pharvarī ..
ṣaṣṭiśca siksaṭī jñeyā tadudāhāramīdṛśam .. 37 ..
3.1.d:
रविवारे च संडे च फाल्गुने चैव फर्वरी ॥
षष्टिश्च सिक्सटी ज्ञेया तदुदाहारमीदृशम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: And for Sunday, 'Sunday'; and for Phālguna, 'February'; / and sixty should be known as 'sixty': such is its example.

3.1.s:
yā pavitrā saptapurī tāsu hiṃsā pravartate ..
dasyavaḥ śabarā bhillā mūrkhā ārye sthitā narāḥ.. 38 ..
3.1.d:
या पवित्रा सप्तपुरी तासु हिंसा प्रवर्तते ॥
दस्यवः शबरा भिल्ला मूर्खा आर्ये स्थिता नराः॥ 38 ॥
3.1.m: In the seven cities that are holy, violence takes place; / Dasyus, Śabaras, and Bhīlas—foolish men reside in the Aryan land.

3.1.s:
mlecchadeśe buddhimato narā vai mlecchadharmiṇaḥ ..
mlecchādhīnā guṇāḥ sarve'vaguṇā āryadeśake .. 39 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छदेशे बुद्धिमतो नरा वै म्लेच्छधर्मिणः ॥
म्लेच्छाधीना गुणाः सर्वेऽवगुणा आर्यदेशके ॥ 39 ॥
3.1.m: In the Mleccha country, men who follow the Mleccha law are intelligent; / all virtues belong to the Mlecchas, while vices are in the Aryan land.

3.1.s:
mleccharājyaṃ bhārate ca taddvīpeṣu smṛtaṃ tathā ..
evaṃ jñātvā muniśreṣṭha hariṃ bhaja mahāmate .. 3.1.5.40 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छराज्यं भारते च तद्द्वीपेषु स्मृतं तथा ॥
एवं ज्ञात्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ हरिं भज महामते ॥ 3.1.5.40 ॥
3.1.m: The Mleccha rule is remembered in Bhārata and in its continents; / knowing this, O best of sages, worship Hari, O great-minded one.

3.1.s:
tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve rodanaṃ cakrire bahu .. 41 ..
kaliyugabhūpākhyānavarṇanam
3.1.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनयः सर्वे रोदनं चक्रिरे बहु ॥ 41 ॥
कलियुगभूपाख्यानवर्णनम्
3.1.m:
Having heard that, all the sages wept copiously.
Description of the Account of the Kings of the Kali Age

3.1.s:
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
brahmāvarte kathaṃ mlecchā na prāptāḥ kāraṇaṃ vada..
sūtaḥ prāha śṛṇuṣvedaṃ sarasvatyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ..1..
3.1.d:
॥ शौनक उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मावर्ते कथं म्लेच्छा न प्राप्ताः कारणं वद॥
सूतः प्राह शृणुष्वेदं सरस्वत्याः प्रभावतः ॥1॥
3.1.m: Śaunaka said: / 'How is it that Mlecchas did not reach Brahmāvarta? Tell the reason.' / Sūta said: 'Listen to this: by the power of Sarasvatī,

3.1.s:
mlecchāḥ prāptā na tatsthāne kāśyapo nāma vai dvijaḥ ..
kalau prāpte sahasrābde svargātprāptaḥ surājñayā .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
म्लेच्छाः प्राप्ता न तत्स्थाने काश्यपो नाम वै द्विजः ॥
कलौ प्राप्ते सहस्राब्दे स्वर्गात्प्राप्तः सुराज्ञया ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m: Mlecchas did not reach that place. A twice-born man named Kāśyapa / arrived from heaven by the gods' command when a thousand years had passed in the Kali age.

3.1.s:
āryāvatī ca tatpatnī daśa putrānakalmaṣān ..
kāśyapātsā labdhavatī teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .. 3 ..
3.1.d:
आर्यावती च तत्पत्नी दश पुत्रानकल्मषान् ॥
काश्यपात्सा लब्धवती तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ॥ 3 ॥
3.1.m: And his wife Āryāvatī obtained from Kāśyapa / ten faultless sons; hear their names from me:

3.1.s:
upādhyāyo dīkṣitaśca pāṭhakaḥ śuklamiśrakau ..
agnihotrī dvivedī ca trivedī pāṇḍya eva ca .. 4 ..
3.1.d:
उपाध्यायो दीक्षितश्च पाठकः शुक्लमिश्रकौ ॥
अग्निहोत्री द्विवेदी च त्रिवेदी पाण्ड्य एव च ॥ 4 ॥
3.1.m: Upādhyāya, Dīkṣita, Pāṭhaka, Śukla, and Miśra, / Agnihotrī, Dvivedī, Trivedī, and Pāṇḍya,

3.1.s:
caturvedīti kathitā nāmatulyaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
teṣāṃ madhye kāśyapaśca sarvajñānamasamanvitaḥ .. 5 ..
3.1.d:
चतुर्वेदीति कथिता नामतुल्यगुणाः स्मृताः ॥
तेषां मध्ये काश्यपश्च सर्वज्ञानमसमन्वितः ॥ 5 ॥
3.1.m: and Caturvedī—these are declared to possess virtues equal to their names. / Among them was Kāśyapa, endowed with all knowledge.

3.1.s:
kāśmīre prāptavānso'pi jagadambāṃ sarasvatīm ..
tuṣṭāva pūjanaṃ kṛtvā raktapuṣpaistvathākṣataiḥ .. 6 ..
3.1.d:
काश्मीरे प्राप्तवान्सोऽपि जगदम्बां सरस्वतीम् ॥
तुष्टाव पूजनं कृत्वा रक्तपुष्पैस्त्वथाक्षतैः ॥ 6 ॥
3.1.m: He went to Kashmir, and to the mother of the universe, Sarasvatī, / he offered praise after worshipping her with red flowers, unbroken grains of rice,

3.1.s: dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ puṣpāṃjalisamanvitaḥ..7.
3.1.d: धूपैर्दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैः पुष्पांजलिसमन्वितः॥7.
3.1.m: incense, lamps, food offerings, and folded hands of flowers.

3.1.s:
.. kāśyapa uvāca .. ..
mātaḥ śaṃkaradayite mayi te karuṇā kuto nāsti..
bho'si tvaṃ jagadaṃbā jagataḥ kiṃ māṃ bahirna yasi ..8..
3.1.d:
॥ काश्यप उवाच ॥ ॥
मातः शंकरदयिते मयि ते करुणा कुतो नास्ति॥
भोऽसि त्वं जगदंबा जगतः किं मां बहिर्न यसि ॥8॥
3.1.m: Kāśyapa said: / 'O Mother, beloved of Śaṅkara, why do you have no compassion on me? / Ah, you are the mother of the universe; why do you not lead me out of the world?

3.1.s:
devi tvaṃ surahetordharmadrohiṇamāśu haṃsi mātaḥ ..
uttamasaṃskṛtabhāṣāṃ tvaṃ kuru mlecchāṃśca mohayeḥ śīghram .. 9 ..
3.1.d:
देवि त्वं सुरहेतोर्धर्मद्रोहिणमाशु हंसि मातः ॥
उत्तमसंस्कृतभाषां त्वं कुरु म्लेच्छांश्च मोहयेः शीघ्रम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.1.m: O Goddess, for the sake of the gods you swiftly kill the enemy of righteousness, O Mother; / make the Sanskrit speech supreme and swiftly delude the Mlecchas!

3.1.s:
aṃba tvaṃ bahurūpā huṃkārā ddhūmralocanaṃ hasi ..
bhīmaṃ durgā daityaṃ hatvā jagatāṃ sukhaṃ nayasi .. 3.1.6.10 ..
3.1.d:
अंब त्वं बहुरूपा हुंकारा द्धूम्रलोचनं हसि ॥
भीमं दुर्गा दैत्यं हत्वा जगतां सुखं नयसि ॥ 3.1.6.10 ॥
3.1.m: O Mother of many forms, with a roar you slay Dhūmralocana; / as Durgā, having killed the fierce demon, you bring happiness to the worlds.

3.1.s:
daṃbhaṃ mohaṃ ghoraṃ garvaṃ hatvā sadā sukhaṃ śeṣe ..
bodhaya mātarjagato duṣṭānnaṣṭā nkuru tvaṃ vai ..
tadā prasannā sā devī bho munestasya mānase .. 11 ..
3.1.d:
दंभं मोहं घोरं गर्वं हत्वा सदा सुखं शेषे ॥
बोधय मातर्जगतो दुष्टान्नष्टा न्कुरु त्वं वै ॥
तदा प्रसन्ना सा देवी भो मुनेस्तस्य मानसे ॥ 11 ॥
3.1.m: Having destroyed hypocrisy, delusion, and terrible pride, you constantly abide in bliss; / enlighten the worlds, O Mother, and destroy the wicked!' / Then that goddess, pleased, in the mind of that sage,

3.1.s:
vāsaṃ kṛtvā dadau jñānaṃ miśradeśe munirgataḥ ..
sarvānmlecchānmohayitvā kṛtvātha tāndvijanmanaḥ .. 12 ..
3.1.d:
वासं कृत्वा ददौ ज्ञानं मिश्रदेशे मुनिर्गतः ॥
सर्वान्म्लेच्छान्मोहयित्वा कृत्वाथ तान्द्विजन्मनः ॥ 12 ॥
3.1.m: making her dwelling, gave him knowledge. The sage went to the land of Miśra; / having deluded all the Mlecchas, he then made them twice-born.

3.1.s:
saṃkhyādaśasahasraṃ ca naravṛndaṃ dvijanmanām ..
dvisahasraṃ smṛtā vaiśyāḥ śeṣāḥ śūdrasutāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 13 ..
3.1.d:
संख्यादशसहस्रं च नरवृन्दं द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
द्विसहस्रं स्मृता वैश्याः शेषाः शूद्रसुताः स्मृताः ॥ 13 ॥
3.1.m: The multitude of twice-born men was ten thousand in number; / two thousand were remembered as Vaiśyas, and the remainder as the sons of Śūdras.

3.1.s:
taiḥ sārddhamāryadeśe sa sarasvatyāḥ prasādataḥ ..
avasadvai muniśreṣṭho munikāryarataḥ sadā .. 14 ..
3.1.d:
तैः सार्द्धमार्यदेशे स सरस्वत्याः प्रसादतः ॥
अवसद्वै मुनिश्रेष्ठो मुनिकार्यरतः सदा ॥ 14 ॥
3.1.m: Together with them, by the grace of Sarasvatī, in the Aryan land / that best of sages lived, always devoted to the duties of a sage.

3.1.s:
teṣāmāryasamūhānāṃ devyāśca varadānataḥ ..
vṛddhirbhavati bahulā catuṣkoṭinarāḥ striyaḥ .. 15 ..
3.1.d:
तेषामार्यसमूहानां देव्याश्च वरदानतः ॥
वृद्धिर्भवति बहुला चतुष्कोटिनराः स्त्रियः ॥ 15 ॥
3.1.m: By the boon granted by the Goddess, of those Aryan communities / a vast increase occurred: forty million men and women.

3.1.s:
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca tadbhūpaḥ kāśyapo muniḥ ..
viṃśottaraśataṃ varṣaṃ tasya rājyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 16 ..
3.1.d:
तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च तद्भूपः काश्यपो मुनिः ॥
विंशोत्तरशतं वर्षं तस्य राज्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.1.m: The sage Kāśyapa was the king over them, their sons, and their grandsons; / his reign is proclaimed to have lasted one hundred and twenty years.

3.1.s:
rājyaputrākhyadeśe ca śūdrāścāṣṭasahasrakāḥ ..
teṣāṃ bhūpaścāryapṛthustasmājjātassa māgadhaḥ .. 17 ..
3.1.d:
राज्यपुत्राख्यदेशे च शूद्राश्चाष्टसहस्रकाः ॥
तेषां भूपश्चार्यपृथुस्तस्माज्जातस्स मागधः ॥ 17 ॥
3.1.m: And in the region known as Rājyaputra there were eight thousand Śūdras; / their king was Āryapṛthu, and from him was born Māgadha.

3.1.s:
māgadhaṃ nāma tatputramabhiṣicya yayau muniḥ ..
iti śrutvā bhṛguśreṣṭhaḥ śaunako harṣamāgataḥ .. 18 ..
3.1.d:
मागधं नाम तत्पुत्रमभिषिच्य ययौ मुनिः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठः शौनको हर्षमागतः ॥ 18 ॥
3.1.m: Having consecrated that son named Māgadha, the sage departed. / Hearing this, Śaunaka, the best of the Bhṛgus, experienced great joy.

3.1.s:
sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ natvā viṣṇudhyānaparo'bhavat ..
punaśca śrutivarṣānte bodhitā munayastathā .. 19..
3.1.d:
सूतं पौराणिकं नत्वा विष्णुध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥
पुनश्च श्रुतिवर्षान्ते बोधिता मुनयस्तथा ॥ 19॥
3.1.m: Having bowed to Sūta, the reciter of the Purāṇas, he became intent upon the meditation of Viṣṇu. / Again, at the end of a year of listening to scripture, the sages were thus enlightened;

3.1.s:
nityanaimittikaṃ kṛtvā papracchuridamādarāt ..
lomaharṣaṇa me brūhi ke rājānaśca māgadhāt ..
kalau rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ yaistu vyāsaśiṣya vadasva naḥ ..3.1.6.20..
3.1.d:
नित्यनैमित्तिकं कृत्वा पप्रच्छुरिदमादरात् ॥
लोमहर्षण मे ब्रूहि के राजानश्च मागधात् ॥
कलौ राज्यं कृतं यैस्तु व्यासशिष्य वदस्व नः ॥3.1.6.20॥
3.1.m: having performed their daily and occasional rites, they asked this with reverence: / 'Tell me, O Lomaharṣaṇa, which kings descended from Māgadha / ruled in the Kali age? Tell us, O disciple of Vyāsa!'

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. . .. ..
māgadho māgadhe deśe prāptavānkāśyapātmajaḥ..21..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥॥।
मागधो मागधे देशे प्राप्तवान्काश्यपात्मजः॥21॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / 'Māgadha, the son of Kāśyapa, arrived in the Magadha country.

3.1.s:
pitṛrājyaṃ smṛtaṃ tena tvāryadeśaḥ pṛthakkṛtaḥ..
pāñcālātpūrvato deśo māgadhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 22 ..
3.1.d:
पितृराज्यं स्मृतं तेन त्वार्यदेशः पृथक्कृतः॥
पाञ्चालात्पूर्वतो देशो मागधः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.1.m: His father's realm was remembered, but the Aryan land was divided by him: / the region to the east of Pāñcāla is proclaimed as Māgadha;

3.1.s:
āgneyyāṃ ca kaliṃgaśca tathāvantastu dakṣiṇe ..
ānartadeśā nairṛtyāṃ siṃdhudeśastu paścime .. 21 ..
3.1.d:
आग्नेय्यां च कलिंगश्च तथावन्तस्तु दक्षिणे ॥
आनर्तदेशा नैरृत्यां सिंधुदेशस्तु पश्चिमे ॥ 21 ॥
3.1.m: in the south-east is Kaliṅga, and Avantī is in the south; / the Ānarta regions are in the south-west, and the Sindhu region is in the west;

3.1.s:
vāyavyāṃ kaikayo deśo madradeśastathottare ..
īśāne caiva koṇindaścāryadeśaśca tatkṛtaḥ ..24..
3.1.d:
वायव्यां कैकयो देशो मद्रदेशस्तथोत्तरे ॥
ईशाने चैव कोणिन्दश्चार्यदेशश्च तत्कृतः ॥24॥
3.1.m: in the north-west is the Kaikaya country, and the Madra country is in the north; / and in the north-east is Koṇinda: thus was the Aryan land made by him.

3.1.s:
deśanāmnā tasya sutā magadhasya mahātmanaḥ ..
tebhyoṃśāni pradattāni tatpaścātkratumudvahan ..25..
3.1.d:
देशनाम्ना तस्य सुता मगधस्य महात्मनः ॥
तेभ्योंशानि प्रदत्तानि तत्पश्चात्क्रतुमुद्वहन् ॥25॥
3.1.m: The sons of that high-souled Magadha were named after the regions; / portions were granted to them, and thereafter he performed a sacrifice.

3.1.s:
balabhadrastadā tuṣṭo yajñabhāvena bhāvitaḥ ..
śiśunāgaḥ kratorjāto balabhadrāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..26..
3.1.d:
बलभद्रस्तदा तुष्टो यज्ञभावेन भावितः ॥
शिशुनागः क्रतोर्जातो बलभद्रांशसंभवः ॥26॥
3.1.m: Balabhadra, pleased at that time, being gratified by the disposition of the sacrifice, / Śiśunāga was born from the sacrifice as an incarnation of a portion of Balabhadra.

3.1.s:
śatavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ kākavarmā suto'bhavat ..
tadrājyaṃ navativarṣaṃ kṣemadharmā tato'bhavat .. 27 ..
3.1.d:
शतवर्षं कृतं राज्यं काकवर्मा सुतोऽभवत् ॥
तद्राज्यं नवतिवर्षं क्षेमधर्मा ततोऽभवत् ॥ 27 ॥
3.1.m: His rule was carried on for a hundred years; Kākavarmā was his son. / His reign was ninety years; after him came Kṣemadharmā.

3.1.s:
aśītivarṣaṃ rājyaṃ tatkṣetraujāstatsuto'bhavat ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vedamiśrastato'bhavat .. 28 ..
3.1.d:
अशीतिवर्षं राज्यं तत्क्षेत्रौजास्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं वेदमिश्रस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.1.m: His reign was eighty years; Kṣetraujas was his son. / The rule was carried on for ten less; after him came Vedamiśra.

3.1.s:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tato'jātaripussutaḥ ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ darbhakastanayo'bhavat .. 29 ..
3.1.d:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं ततोऽजातरिपुस्सुतः ॥
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं दर्भकस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥ 29 ॥
3.1.m: The rule was carried on for ten less; then Ajātaripu was his son. / The rule was carried on for ten less; Darbhaka was his son.

3.1.s:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyamudayāśvastato'bhavat ..
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ naṃdavardhana eva tat .. 3.1.6.30 ..
3.1.d:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यमुदयाश्वस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं नंदवर्धन एव तत् ॥ 3.1.6.30 ॥
3.1.m: The rule was carried on for ten less; after him was Udayāśva. / The rule was carried on for ten less, and that was Nandavardhana.

3.1.s:
daśahīnaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmānnaṃdasuto'bhavat ..
pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śūdrīgarbhasamudbhavaḥ .. 31 ..
3.1.d:
दशहीनं कृतं राज्यं तस्मान्नंदसुतोऽभवत् ॥
पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं राज्यं शूद्रीगर्भसमुद्भवः ॥ 31 ॥
3.1.m: The rule was carried on for ten less; from him was born Nanda, his son. / The rule was carried on equal to his father's; he was born from the womb of a Śūdra woman.

3.1.s:
nandājjātaḥ pranandaśca daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājātaḥ parānandaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 32 ..
3.1.d:
नन्दाज्जातः प्रनन्दश्च दशवर्षं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्माजातः परानन्दः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.1.m: From Nanda was born Prananda, and he held office for ten years; / from him was born Parānanda, and he held office equal to his father.

3.1.s:
tasmājjātassamānaṃdo viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
tasmājātaḥ priyānaṃdaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 33 ..
3.1.d:
तस्माज्जातस्समानंदो विंशद्वर्षं कृतं पदम् ॥
तस्माजातः प्रियानंदः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.1.m: From him was born Samānanda, who held office for twenty years; / from him was born Priyānanda, who held office equal to his father.

3.1.s:
devānaṃdastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
yajñabhaṃgaḥ sutastasmātpiturarddhaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 34..
3.1.d:
देवानंदस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
यज्ञभंगः सुतस्तस्मात्पितुरर्द्धं कृतं पदम् ॥ 34॥
3.1.m: Devānanda was his son, who held office equal to his father; / Yajñabhaṅga was the son after him, who held office for half his father's time.

3.1.s:
mauryānaṃdastasya sutaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam ..
mahānandastato jātaḥ pitustulyaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 35 ..
3.1.d:
मौर्यानंदस्तस्य सुतः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥
महानन्दस्ततो जातः पितुस्तुल्यं कृतं पदम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.1.m: Mauryānanda was his son, who held office equal to his father; / Mahānanda was born after him, who held office equal to his father.

3.1.s:
etasminneva kāle tu kalinā saṃsmṛto hariḥ ..
kāśyapādudbhavo devo gautamo nāma viśrutaḥ .. 36 ..
3.1.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कलिना संस्मृतो हरिः ॥
काश्यपादुद्भवो देवो गौतमो नाम विश्रुतः ॥ 36 ॥
3.1.m: At that very time, Hari was remembered by Kali; / a divine being was born from Kāśyapa, celebrated by the name Gautama.

3.1.s:
bauddhadharmaṃ ca saṃskatya paṭṭaṇe prāptavānhariḥ ..
daśavarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmācchākyamuniḥ smṛtaḥ .. 37 ..
3.1.d:
बौद्धधर्मं च संस्कत्य पट्टणे प्राप्तवान्हरिः ॥
दशवर्षं कृतं राज्यं तस्माच्छाक्यमुनिः स्मृतः ॥ 37 ॥
3.1.m: And refining the Buddhist religion, Hari arrived in Paṭṭaṇa; / his rule was carried on for ten years; from him is remembered Śākyamuni.

3.1.s:
viṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ tasmācchuddhodano'bhavat ..
triṃśadvarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ śākya siṃhastato'bhavat .. 38 ..
3.1.d:
विंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं तस्माच्छुद्धोदनोऽभवत् ॥
त्रिंशद्वर्षं कृतं राज्यं शाक्य सिंहस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.1.m: For twenty years he ruled, and from him arose Śuddhodana. / For thirty years he ruled, and from him then arose Śākyasiṃha.

3.1.s:
śatādrau dvisahasre'bde vyatīte so'bhavannṛpaḥ ..
kaleḥ prathamacaraṇe vedamārgo vināśitaḥ .. 39 ..
3.1.d:
शताद्रौ द्विसहस्रेऽब्दे व्यतीते सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥
कलेः प्रथमचरणे वेदमार्गो विनाशितः ॥ 39 ॥
3.1.m: When two thousand one hundred years had passed, he became king. / In the first quarter of the Kali [age], the path of the Vedas was destroyed.

3.1.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ sarvabauddhā narāḥ smṛtāḥ..
nareṣu viṣṇurnṛpatiryathā rājā tathā prajāḥ..3.1.6.40..
3.1.d:
षष्टिवर्षं कृतं राज्यं सर्वबौद्धा नराः स्मृताः॥
नरेषु विष्णुर्नृपतिर्यथा राजा तथा प्रजाः॥3.1.6.40॥
3.1.m: For sixty years he ruled, and all men were considered Buddhists. / Among men, the king is Viṣṇu; as is the king, so are the subjects.

3.1.s:
viṣṇorvīryānusāreṇa jagaddharmaḥ pravarttate ..
tasminharau ye śaraṇaṃ prāptā māyāpatau narāḥ .. 41 ..
3.1.d:
विष्णोर्वीर्यानुसारेण जगद्धर्मः प्रवर्त्तते ॥
तस्मिन्हरौ ये शरणं प्राप्ता मायापतौ नराः ॥ 41 ॥
3.1.m: In accordance with the power of Viṣṇu, universal order operates. / The men who have taken refuge in that Hari, the lord of Māyā,

3.1.s:
api pāpasamācārā mokṣavaṃtaḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
śakyasiṃhādbuddhasiṃhaḥ piturarthaṃ kṛtaṃ padam .. 42 ..
3.1.d:
अपि पापसमाचारा मोक्षवंतः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
शक्यसिंहाद्बुद्धसिंहः पितुरर्थं कृतं पदम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.1.m: even if of sinful conduct, are declared to attain liberation. / From Śākyasiṃha came Buddhasiṃha; he held the station for his father's duration.

3.1.s:
caṃdraguptastasya sutaḥ paurasā dhipateḥ sutām ..
sulūvasya tathodvāhya yāvanībauddhatatparaḥ .. 43 ..
3.1.d:
चंद्रगुप्तस्तस्य सुतः पौरसा धिपतेः सुताम् ॥
सुलूवस्य तथोद्वाह्य यावनीबौद्धतत्परः ॥ 43 ॥
3.1.m: Candragupta was his son; having married the daughter of Sulūva, / the ruler of the Paurasas, he was devoted to the Yavana Buddhist [doctrine].

3.1.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ biṃdusārastato'bhavat ..
pitṛstulya kṛtaṃ rājyamaśokastanayo'bhavat ..44..
3.1.d:
षष्टिवर्षं कृतं राज्यं बिंदुसारस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
पितृस्तुल्य कृतं राज्यमशोकस्तनयोऽभवत् ॥44॥
3.1.m: For sixty years he ruled, and then arose Bindusāra. / He ruled equal [in years] to his father, and Aśoka became his son.

3.1.s:
etasminneva kāle tu kānyakubjo dvijottamaḥ ..
arbudaṃ śikharaṃ prāpya brahmahomamathākarot ..45..
3.1.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कान्यकुब्जो द्विजोत्तमः ॥
अर्बुदं शिखरं प्राप्य ब्रह्महोममथाकरोत् ॥45॥
3.1.m: At that very time, a foremost twice-born of Kānyakubja, / having reached the peak of Arbuda, then performed a brahma-fire sacrifice.

3.1.s:
vedamaṃtraprabhāvācca jātāścatvāri kṣatriyāḥ ..
pramarassāmavedī ca capahāniryajurvidaḥ..46..
3.1.d:
वेदमंत्रप्रभावाच्च जाताश्चत्वारि क्षत्रियाः ॥
प्रमरस्सामवेदी च चपहानिर्यजुर्विदः॥46॥
3.1.m: And by the power of the Vedic mantras, four kṣatriyas were born: / Pramara, knower of the Sāmaveda, and Capahāni, knower of the Yajurveda;

3.1.s:
trivedī ca tathā śuklotharvā sa parihārakaḥ ..
airāvatakule jātāngajānāruhya te pṛthak ..47..
3.1.d:
त्रिवेदी च तथा शुक्लोथर्वा स परिहारकः ॥
ऐरावतकुले जातान्गजानारुह्य ते पृथक् ॥47॥
3.1.m: and likewise Śukla, knower of the three Vedas, and Parihāra, follower of the Atharva[veda]. / Having separately mounted elephants born of the lineage of Airāvata,

3.1.s:
aśokaṃ svavaśaṃ cakussarve bauddhā vināśitāḥ ..
caturlakṣāḥ smṛtā bauddhāḥ divyaśastraiḥ prahāritāḥ .. 48 ..
3.1.d:
अशोकं स्ववशं चकुस्सर्वे बौद्धा विनाशिताः ॥
चतुर्लक्षाः स्मृता बौद्धाः दिव्यशस्त्रैः प्रहारिताः ॥ 48 ॥
3.1.m: they brought Aśoka under their control, and all the Buddhists were destroyed. / Four hundred thousand Buddhists, it is remembered, were struck down with divine weapons.

3.1.s:
avante pramaro bhūpaścaturyojanavistṛtām ..
ambāvatīṃ nāma purīmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 49 ..
3.1.d:
अवन्ते प्रमरो भूपश्चतुर्योजनविस्तृताम् ॥
अम्बावतीं नाम पुरीमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् ॥ 49 ॥
3.1.m: In Avanti, King Pramara, occupying the city named Ambāvatī, / four yojanas wide, became joyful.

3.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
citrakūṭagirerdeśe parihāro mahīpatiḥ ..
kaliṃjarapuraṃ ramyamakrośāyatanaṃ smṛtam .. 1 ..
3.1.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चित्रकूटगिरेर्देशे परिहारो महीपतिः ॥
कलिंजरपुरं रम्यमक्रोशायतनं स्मृतम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.1.m: Sūta said: / In the region of Mount Citrakūṭa, King Parihāra, / [occupying] the charming city of Kaliñjara, remembered as extending across a krośa,

3.1.s:
adhyāsya bauddhahaṃtā sa sukhitobhavadūrjitaḥ ..
rājaputrākhyadeśe ca capahānirmahīpatiḥ .. 2 ..
3.1.d:
अध्यास्य बौद्धहंता स सुखितोभवदूर्जितः ॥
राजपुत्राख्यदेशे च चपहानिर्महीपतिः ॥ 2 ॥
3.1.m: occupying [it], that slayer of Buddhists became happy and mighty. / And in the region called Rājaputra, King Capahāni,

3.1.s:
ajamerapuraṃ ramyaṃ vidhiśobhāsamanvitam ..
cāturvarṇyayutaṃ divyamadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 3 ..
3.1.d:
अजमेरपुरं रम्यं विधिशोभासमन्वितम् ॥
चातुर्वर्ण्ययुतं दिव्यमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.1.m: occupying the charming and splendid city of Ajamere, endowed with proper beauty / and inhabited by the four castes, became happy.

3.1.s:
śuklo nāma mahīpālo gata ānarta'maṃḍale ..
dvārakāṃ nāma nagarīmadhyāsya sukhito'bhavat .. 4 .. .
3.1.d:
शुक्लो नाम महीपालो गत आनर्तऽमंडले ॥
द्वारकां नाम नगरीमध्यास्य सुखितोऽभवत् ॥ 4 ॥ ।
3.1.m: The king named Śukla went to the territory of Ānarta; / occupying the city named Dvārakā, he became happy.

3.1.s:

viṃśadbhiḥ karmayogaṃ ca samārādhya śivo'bhavat ..

3.1.m: having fully practised the yoga of action for twenty [years], he became Śiva. / When thirty centuries were completed and the terrible Kali [age] arrived,

3.1.m: was sent to him by Śiva, and he accepted that station. / A vetāla, created by Pārvatī for his protection, went [to him].

3.1.m: [Chapter] 4 [page] 255: The account of the sacrifice of the Mlecchas; the praise of Viṣṇu uttered by Kali; the granting of a boon to Kali by Viṣṇu; the departure of Sūta, Śaunaka, and the others toward the Himavat mountains upon beholding the decline of the Āryan land; the commencement of the narration of future events by the great sage Vyāsa, having made his own mind the listener; in the description of the rise of the land of the Mlecchas, the accounts of Ādama, Śveta, Anuha, Kīnāśa, Mahallalla, Virada, Hanūka, Matācchila, Homaka, Nyūha, Sīma, Śama, and Bhāva; during Nyūha's embarkation on a boat together with the sages, the submergence of Bhāratavarṣa under rainwater; the praise of the Goddess uttered by the sages; the account of Nyūha's dwelling on the earth. Verses: 60.

3.1.m: [Chapter] 5 [page] 256: The account of the lineage of Nyūha; the rule of the language of the Mlecchas; the account of the kingly lineages of the Mlecchas beginning with Sima, Hāma, Yākūta, Jumra, Mājūja, Mādī, Yūnāna, Ilīśa, Taralīśa, Kittī, Hūdā, and so forth; the account of Sima's Mleccha lineage after Sūta arose from his yogic sleep; the description of the nature of the corrupt dialects derived from the Sanskrit language; the distinction between the languages of Vraja, Mahārāṣṭra, the Yavanas, and the Guruṇḍas; the explanation of several corrupt words found in the language of the Yavanas and others. Verses: 41.

3.1.m:
[Chapter] 6 [page] 257: In the explanation of the reason for the non-arrival of the Mlecchas in Āryāvarta, the account of the brahmin Kāśyapa; the hymn of praise to Sarasvatī within the region of Kaśmīra composed by the brahmin Kāśyapa; Kāśyapa's dwelling in Brahmāvarta, having received a boon from Sarasvatī and made the Mlecchas his disciples; the account of the royal lineage of Magadha; the account of the reform of the Buddhist religion in the city, beginning with the birth of Gautama; the origin of the four kṣatriyas—Pramara, the knower of the Sāmaveda, Capahāni, the knower of the Yajurveda, and so forth—from the performance of a Brahma-fire-sacrifice on Mount Arbuda by a Kānyakubja twice-born. Verses: 49.
[Chapter] 7 [page] 298: The dwelling of the Pramaras, Capahānis, and Śuklas in the cities of Kaliñjara, Ajamerapura, and Dvārakā; in the detailed account of the Fire Dynasty, the history of the Pramara dynasty; the incarnation of Vikramāditya in the Pramara dynasty; the arrival of the vetāla in the form of a brahmin in the assembly of Vikramāditya; the dialogue between the vetāla and Vikrama. Verses: 26.
